- **export mode**: The client_binary, server_binary and server_xml markings on a tunable; client_binary fields are copied into SimData. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **export modes**: The flags on a tunable that decide whether it is exported for the client, the server, or both. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **extra personality trait slot**: A per-Sim set of trait ids that hold a personality trait without using a slot; the reincarnation picker fills it. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
## F

- **facial attributes blob**: The bytes of BlobSimFacialCustomizationData (sculpts, face, body and aged modifier lists) that Python stores and sends unchanged. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **faction reputation**: A Sim's standing with the First Order, the Resistance or the scoundrels of Batuu (GP09), held as a ranked statistic. ([4.03](4.03-groups-factions.md))
- **failed decompile**: A compiled Python module for which the decompiler produced no source; 126 of the 3,265 in this version, 89 of them gameplay. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **`FAILED_TOO_STRESSED`**: Exam or treatment result for a stressed pet; its loots run but the action is not recorded. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **failure**: The commodity threshold (-100 by default) at which the first tuned failure interaction that succeeds, such as passing out or death, is pushed at critical priority. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **fake duration**: How long a festival node stays active when the player is not on its street (fake_duration, Sim minutes). ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **fake perform**: Doing a service's work without spawning the NPC, when too little of the window remains or the window passed while the zone was unloaded. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **fake score**: A rival score with sim id 0 added on a timer during a contest. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **fallback forecast**: FALLBACK_FORECAST: forecast_Default, one 24 hour partly cloudy warm block, used when a place has no usable forecast list. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **fallback output**: The phase output used when no tuned output passes; it is recorded with key -1. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **false advertisement**: A tuned ad that replaces the real one for a statistic, so an interaction can promise more or less than it gives. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **Fame**: EP06 ranked statistic rankedStatistic_Fame whose ranks 0 to 5 are the celebrity stars. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **FamePerkBucks**: Currency for the 21 fame perks; earned 1, 2, 2, 2, 3 at the first reach of stars 1 to 5. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **FameQuirkBucks**: Currency for the 12 fame quirks; given every time stars 1, 3 and 5 are reached and taken back with force_refund on rank-down. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **familiar**: A GP08 companion bound to a spellcaster: a pet cat or dog, or one of 11 object familiars. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **family bit**: A relationship bit such as sibling, cousin or grandparent that the family tree writes between relatives. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **family recipe**: An EP18 recipe variant with an extra ingredient and a buff, passed between family members. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **family tree**: The graph of Sims and parent, child and partner edges that the game uses to find relatives. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **`fans_cap`**: Tested variant on each fan-supporting zone director capping fans on the lot (5, or 3, 1, 0 in listed regions). ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **FanSituationManager**: Zone-director helper that every 15 Sim minutes spawns stans and up to a capped number of fans for celebrities on the lot. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **fashion trend**: One of nine clothing styles whose popularity statistic drifts every hour (EP12 High School Years). ([4.03](4.03-groups-factions.md))
- **fat and fit commodities**: commodity_Fitness_Fat and commodity_Fitness_Fit, -100 to 100, derived from the physique as (heavy - lean) x 100 and (fit - bony) x 100. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **Fat and Fit states**: Object states 15151 and 15179 that cut each fitness commodity into five 40-point bands; a band change triggers the physique update. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **fat commodity**: commodity_Fitness_Fat (16589), -100 to 100, mapped to heavy minus lean times 100. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **favorite recipe**: A Sim's stored recipe for a set of recipe tags; a favorite-recipe start crafts it without opening the picker. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **favourite stack**: A Sim's remembered favourite stack of identical objects in the inventory, kept per object definition. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **favourite vehicle**: The vehicle chosen first for the Sim's current surface type (land or water), by tag. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **fear**: A trait of type FEAR (14 installed) that brings a whim set with a confrontation want; trait_Fear_Unfulfilled can come from an empty Fulfillment. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **fertilizer cooldown**: The commodity that blocks fertilizing a plant again for about 71 Sim hours after each use. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **festival**: A FestivalDramaNode: a timed street event with an open street director, a pre-period and a fake length. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **festival contest**: A festival with contest tuning: fake rival scores, player entries, ranked or weighted random winners and prizes. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **festival director**: Open street director that runs a festival as a chain of states (spin-up, main or performances, cooldown, cleanup). ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **festival notification option**: A per-pack key (festival_0 to festival_7) the player can disable to hide that pack's festival notifications. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **festival test**: One of three tests (festival_running, next_festival, time_until_festival) that ask whether a festival is on or coming; no live record uses them in this install. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **FGL search flag**: One of 22 bits that steer an FGL search, such as testing build/buy footprints, staying in the current room or staying outside. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **File index depth**: How far a chapter read each of its modules: deep (read and explained), skim (read for the table) or listed (only its names read). ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **filter term**: One condition inside a Sim filter that scores a Sim from 0 up and can conform a newly made Sim to match. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **find good location (FGL)**: The native search that finds a free, reachable spot for an object or Sim near a start point, within a maximum distance. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **finishing type**: The reason an interaction ended (25 values); the first one recorded wins. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **fire code**: Engine limits on how many objects of a kind a lot or household may hold; mannequins and elevators are tuned. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **fire meter**: SimInfoFireMeter: a repeating 120 Sim minute check that forces a population cull (the max-population story action) when Sim infos pass the cap by 15% (1,197 live); it triggers culling outside the night window. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md), [3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md), [4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **fire object**: The `Fire` object spawned on a burning spot, with a strength commodity that decays to put it out. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **fire quadtree**: The fire service's spatial index of fires, used to keep new fires apart; dropped when the last fire ends. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **fire spread**: The repeating fire-service alarm that tries to place a new fire 0.8 to 1.2 m from a random existing one. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **firemeter**: A spawner's cap on how many of its spawned objects may exist at once (fixed or chosen by state). ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **fish freshness**: A fish commodity that falls from 300 at 0.2 per minute through six freshness states, foul after about 25 hours. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **fishing data**: A snippet listing a fishing spot's fish, treasures and the weights of fish, junk and treasure. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **fit commodity**: commodity_Fitness_Fit (16590), -100 to 100, mapped to fit minus bony times 100. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **FitnessLiability**: Liability added to a physique reaction; when the reaction ends it calls update_fitness_state. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **fixed64**: Protobuf wire type for 8 raw little-endian bytes; most ids in a save use it. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **flammable quadtree**: The fire service's spatial index of fire-related objects and their flammable areas, used to find what a fire touches. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **flat scenario**: A scenario with no starting phase; all its goals are active at once and the first to complete ends it. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **flavor interaction**: A short idle action a walk-by Sim plays, gated by a per-situation chance and cooldown. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **floor feature**: An engine-stored floor mark: burnt, leaf or dust. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **flowing puddle**: The component that keeps placing or growing puddles around an object while its `flowing_puddle_enabled` flag is on. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **flush**: The moment queued arbs are merged, their events run and the blocks are sent; it happens when an interaction's basic content ends. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **FNV-1**: The hash family the game uses for names and resource types: over the lower-cased text, multiply by the FNV prime, then xor each byte. The 32-bit form gives type ids and string ids, the 64-bit form instance ids. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **focus event**: An op that adds, removes or changes a temporary look-at record between a Sim and a target on a priority layer. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **focus score**: An object's weight in the client's random choice of what a Sim looks at; live values none 0, low 1, medium 10, high 40. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **FocusCamera**: Camera op 186 that points the camera at an object id or a location, optionally following. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **followers**: A social media commodity recounted once a day from posts, reactions and the current count. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **food poisoning chance**: A recipe roll that would put the poisoned state on a dish; inert in this install because the state is defined only in GP03 patch data. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **food restriction**: A restricted ingredient group a Sim can hold (live: only Dairy); recipes list the groups they contain (Dairy on 181) and FoodRestrictionTest checks one against the other. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **footprint**: The polygons an object occupies for placement and routing; stored in FTPT resources. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **`force_refund`**: Bucks loot option: if the balance would go negative, refund perks until it is back to zero. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **forecast**: A WeatherForecast instance: a day's menu of weather events by starting hour, each with a weight and a duration. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **forecast list**: The weather_forcast_list snippet: weighted forecasts for one part of one season at one place. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **forecast override**: A forecast list that replaces a place's seasonal forecasts for the season it was set in, or across seasons when marked cross-season. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **foreign-lot buff**: `Buff_OnForeignLot`, given to an NPC on a lot that is not its home; its commodity falls from 100 to 0 over 12 Sim hours (homesickness). ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **form trait**: The current_occult_trait that marks which form is showing (for example trait_OccultVampire_DarkForm). ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **formation behaviour**: An action a routing formation runs on a trigger (route stop or interaction start), such as pushing an interaction on the slave. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **free service trait**: One of two traits that make every hired service cost nothing for that household. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **Fresh Chef**: A cooking trait whose food is put in the outstanding state (quality midpoint 40.5) before the grade is added, so a low-skill Fresh Chef can still finish at normal. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **freshness**: The commodity_freshness statistic on food, starting at 120 and falling 0.2 per Sim minute, scaled by the inventory the food sits in. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **front door**: The exterior door the door service picks by estimated path from the lot arrival point, marked FrontDoor_IsFrontDoor. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **Frozen perk**: A small-business perk (EP18) locked without refund while the owner fails its business rank's level tests, and unlocked again for free when they pass. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **frozen timeline**: A stand-in timeline used during travel that holds the current time and accepts no new work until the next zone starts. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **frozen water**: The WATER_FROZEN channel: ponds and fountains freeze at Freezing and thaw above Cold; 0.002 (0.2 percent) or more counts as Frozen_Water. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **fruit counter**: The commodity `commodity_Collection_SpawnSlotObject`; each time it reaches 0 the plant places one fruit in a free slot. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **fruit decay**: The fruit commodity that moves a fruit from New through Ripe, Fallen and Picked to Rotten and Decayed. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **FTUE**: First-time user experience: the tutorial mode (2) used by the scripted new-player tutorial, which hides most pie-menu actions and disables UI elements. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **Fulfillment**: commodity_Sim_Fulfillment, 0 to 100, which falls over about three days without a finished want and resets when one is finished. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **full autonomy**: The FullAutonomy mode: scores whole interactions on objects, Sims and the inventory; blocked at the LIMITED_ONLY setting and below. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **full build**: A ClientFullBuild or SimulationFullBuild package: the base game's or a pack's content as first installed, never rewritten by later patches. The delta build is a patch layer over it, so resources the delta neither replaces nor deletes still load from the full build; the combined tuning, though, shares its resource key with the delta's copy, which replaces it whole, so the game does not read the full build's tuning (inferred: the resolver is native). Only the base game's is XML text. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md), [0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md), [8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **FULL LOD**: Level 100, played Sims outside the active household; keeps unlocks, whims, notebook, royalty, relics and other FULL trackers. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **funds source**: Where an interaction's cost is paid from: household, business, statistic, bucks or no source (FundsSource). ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **Fury**: commodity_Motive_Werewolf_Fury, 0 to 500, climbing 0.1 a minute; rampage at 499. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
## G

- **gallery**: EA's online library of shared lots, rooms and households, run by the client and EA's servers. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **`gallery_download_venue_map`**: Region map that converts a gallery venue type to one the region allows on download. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **`gallery_load_behavior`**: Statistic setting that decides whether a gallery Sim or downloaded object keeps the statistic. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **`gallery_upload_venue_type`**: Venue setting naming the venue type the lot is uploaded to the gallery as. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **game breaker**: A job flag that lets its request spawn a Sim even at the NPC soft cap. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **game clock**: The GameClock service: game time as ticks advanced each frame by real time times the speed multiplier, plus an offset for the saved time. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **game effect modifier**: A lasting effect carried by a buff (16 kinds), such as autonomy_modifier, effective_skill_modifier or mood_effect_modifier: autonomy, affordance score and success, effective skill, stat rates, static values, mood weights, pie menu filters, decay, sell price. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md), [3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **game group**: A side group anchored to an object with a game component; it ends when the game ends. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **game option test**: The `game_option` test: passes when a player gameplay option is on (or off with invert); fails outright when the option's pack is missing. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **game service**: A service built once when a save loads (only if none exists) that lives for the whole save and survives travel between lots, such as the game clock, the time service, households and relationships; 74 in the code. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **game tick**: The game clock's smallest step: 25 per Sim second, 1,500 per Sim minute; one passes per real millisecond at normal speed. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **GameContentData**: Packs and content-patch state a save records: required_pack_ids, cds_patch_base_changelists, cds_content_patch_mounted. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **gameplay object preference**: A GameplayObjectPreference trait recording how a Sim feels about one object definition: UNSURE, DISLIKE, LIKE or LOVE. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **gameplay options**: Account-level settings (autosave, story progression, pack options) loaded into every service from the GameplayOptions message. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **gameplay values**: Key and value pairs of an account, sent to the account store on each save and read on client connect. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **GameplaySaveSlotData**: SaveSlotData.gameplay_data: world time, camera, travel seed, field 6 enable_autogeneration_same_sex_preference, and fields 7 to 64, mostly one per save-wide service (12 and 52 are not services). ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **gardening component**: The object component (key `gardening`) that makes an object a plant, a fruit, a fruitless house plant or a grafting shoot. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **gardening help**: An EP11 animal state: when a watched plant gets weeds or pests, one helping rabbit, goat or sheep is sent to search. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **gender chance**: The statistic (statistic_Pregnancy_GenderChance) whose position in its range is the chance of a girl. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **Gender option trait (pet)**: The trait that decides whether a pet can reproduce; generated adoptable pets get "cannot reproduce" four times out of five. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **gender preference**: Per-gender statistics and traits that decide whom a Sim finds romantically or woohoo attractive. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **genetics seed**: A random integer rolled at conception for each baby and passed to native generate_offspring to mix the parents' genetic data. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **GEOM**: Mesh resource (type 0x015A1849): vertices (position, normal, UV sets, colour, bone indexes and weights, and on some meshes a vertex id), indices, stitches, slot rays, bone hashes and a texture key list; every live mesh is version 15. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md), [8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **germination**: The fruit commodity whose arrival at its convergence turns a fruit into a planted plant; it does not decay on its own. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **getaway**: Travel group type tied to a player-planned getaway event, with a daily profit at home or a daily cost away. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **getaway challenge**: An EP20 getaway rule that runs daily, such as eliminating one Sim or reshuffling activities. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **ghost route**: A path planned while ignoring obstacles, used when a Sim with a teleport style will teleport instead of walking. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **ghost trait**: A trait of type GHOST given for a death type; it stops aging and a second death. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **ghost-only trait**: A trait in Ghost.GHOST_ONLY_TRAITS that is removed when a Sim stops being a ghost. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **gig**: A scheduled job inside a career, paid by result. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **gig history**: The record a finished gig leaves: result, score, title and the before and after photos, keyed by customer or lot. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **global flag**: A bit in a session-wide bitmask that tuning tests can check; not saved. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **global importer**: The ModuleSuiteImporter that native start-up installs first on sys.meta_path through c_api_register_global_importer; it only acts on modules whose source is available. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **global lot cleanup**: OBJECT_CLEANUP_TUNING actions applied to a counted number of objects on each lot load. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **global policy**: An EP07 island-wide goal with progress 0 to 100 that turns its effects on at the maximum and decays later. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **global service**: A service that lives for the whole game session, such as persistence, the distributor and tuning loading. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **global test set**: A TunableGlobalTestSet (test_globals): a flat AND list that moves failing tests to the front for next time. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **GlobalLightSettings**: The client's single record of global lighting constants (sunlight scale, window sun angle and others). ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **go dancing**: A social event in another zone run by a SOCIAL_EVENT zone director that gives each selectable Sim its own party-goer situation. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **goal cost**: The cost of ending in a destination node, in metres: in-use and reservation penalties, preferences, relationship bonuses. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **goal graph**: The graph built from a situation's minor goal chains: the first goal of each goal set is a node and chained sets are its successors. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **goal re-check**: A scenario goal flagged should_reevaluate_on_load is re-tested as soon as it is set up (scenario start, phase start, load, sequence step) and completes at once if its tests already pass. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **goal sequence**: An ordered list of phase goals; only one goal per sequence is active, and completing it activates the next. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **grab serving**: The interaction that takes one serving from a dish as a new object and copies the dish's freshness, quality and a few other states onto it. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **graduation**: The EP12 ceremony that ends high school, held as a Sunday drama node. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **graft**: Attaching a shoot to a plant, which adds the shoot's fruit as an extra fruit spawner and sets the plant back to Seedling. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **graphed goal tracker**: A situation goal tracker that offers up to three minor goals at once from a graph of goal chains, unlocking a goal when all goals leading to it are complete. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **greeted bit**: A temporary bit marking that two Sims have greeted; it is cleared when a Sim spawns or the zone loads. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **greeted status**: Whether a visiting NPC may move freely in a home: NOT_APPLICABLE, WAITING or GREETED. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **ground frost**: Snow cover held at up to 0.1 (FROST_GROUND_ACCUMULATION_MAX) at Freezing with no snow falling. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **group cooking**: A shared cooking activity where helpers add quality every 15 minutes and the head cook gets a +30 finish and 12 servings. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **group dance**: A situation base that reserves a dance floor, places a jig and routes each dancer to a jig part before dancing. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **group id**: The 32-bit middle part of a resource key; 0 for most content, the pack number for combined tuning, a size or variant for thumbnails. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **growth part**: A facial or body hair part (body type 28 or 78 to 81) stored in the genetic block's growth list (GeneticData.growth_parts_list). ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **growth spurt**: The 5:00 to 6:00 window in which a blossoming plant's fruit counter runs 50 times faster; outside it the counter is locked. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **growth stage**: The plant state read off the growth counter: Planted (below 2.1), Seedling (to 24.48), Mature (to 99) or Blossoming (99 to 100). ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **GSI**: Game Server Inspector: EA's in-house web view of server state, served over HTTP from the game; compiled out of retail (SUPPORT_GSI is False), so its services and HTTP server are off. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **GSI archiver**: A rolling, compressed record log that game code writes to and the Game Server Inspector reads back; disabled in retail. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **GSI handler**: A function registered with @GsiHandler(path, schema) that returns JSON data for one GSI page. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **GSI view cheat**: A button on a GSI page that runs a console command for the selected row. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **guaranteed**: A super interaction that is still protected from displacement because it has not yet delivered its content. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **guest list**: A SituationGuestList of SituationGuestInfo entries (Sim, job, spawning option, priority, reservation) plus the invite-only flag and host. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **guid64**: The id a record uses when referenced and saved; equal to the instance id except for slot types, which use the name hash. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **guidance**: The guided Live-mode tutorial; while its auto option is on and it is unfinished, pivotal moments are minimized instead of started. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **guidance tip**: A GUIDANCE_TIP instance: an onboarding hint whose rules and actions are all run by the client; the server's hooks are empty. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
## H

- **HairGrowthFlags**: Bits in the Sim record's flags that switch body hair growth on per area: face, arms, legs, chest and back. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **half wall**: A low wall object with a posture location on each side. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **hamper**: An object tagged `Func_Laundry_Hamper` that takes clothing piles until its full-hamper state is set (SP13). ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **handedness**: A Sim's preferred carrying hand: a trait if present, otherwise left for one Sim id in four. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **hard stop**: Ending an element at once, including its children, with no chance to finish. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **head start**: A deterministic random starting point on the age bar that a newly generated Sim gets once on its first load. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **headline**: A HEADLINE instance: the floating icon and value shown over a Sim when a preference, ranked statistic, relationship or bucks value changes. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **hero object**: An object tagged `Func_Laundry_Hero_Object` whose presence turns on the laundry system for a household (SP13). ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **hidden false advertisement**: A fake ad that adds to the score but is not part of the interaction's commodity flags, so it never makes the interaction a candidate. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **hidden household**: A household removed from normal play: no lot, no player flags, funds reset; used for service NPCs and culled Sims kept for the family tree. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **hidden mood buff**: The MoodBuff_Hidden_* buff added for the active mood and step; its game effects are what a mood actually changes. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **high-water GC**: A native generation-2 garbage collection that runs only when a memory trigger has been reached, tried at pause, dialogs, Build/Buy exit and zone spin-up. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **hitting their marks**: The short phase after spin-up in which the game advances in small fixed steps so Sims settle into their restored interactions before the player sees the lot. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **holiday**: A day on the season calendar (EP05) with a list of traditions; runs as a drama node from 06:00 for HOLIDAY_DURATION (20 hours). ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **holiday definition**: The HolidayDefinition instance: name, icon, up to 5 traditions, time-off flags, decoration preset, audio sting. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **holiday hunt**: A per-holiday set of searched object ids that marks objects already searched that day. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **holiday medal**: Bronze, silver or gold from a Sim's holiday situation score as a percent of its max score (100 or 300). ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **holiday tracker**: Per active household state of the upcoming and active holiday and its traditions; exists even without EP05. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **holstering**: Stowing a carried object while routing or changing posture, and taking it out again. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **home chef**: A hired chef situation locked to a fixed menu preset, using the restaurant ordering code at a home lot. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **homeless animal**: An animal object the animal service knows but has assigned to no home; it moves in first when a home gets new inhabitants. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **homeless household**: A household with no home lot (home zone 0); townies and candidates for story move-ins. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **homework help**: A daily chance that a parent's help advances a student's homework, limited to tuned regions. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **Horse competition**: An EP14 snippet describing an event a rider and horse enter for a fee, with weighted placements and prizes. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **household funds**: The household's Simoleon balance (FamilyFunds), capped at 9,999,999 by live module tuning; every Sim in the household spends from it. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **household inventory proxy**: A transient object standing in for household inventory; removed when build mode opens. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **household milestone**: A milestone tracked for a whole household, with objectives and an optional notice. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **household slot**: One of the 8 places in a household; members, pregnancies and adoptions in progress use them. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **household template**: A tuned list of Sim templates, member chances, funds and relationships used to create a whole household. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **household template fixup**: The one-time step at zone spin-up that gives a premade household its template relationships, townie street home world and rental lots, then clears the template id. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **household tracker**: A per-household data holder (bucks, laundry, missing pets, delivery, collection, object preference, story progression, scenario) cleaned when the household's top LOD drops below its threshold. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **housing kick-out**: The EP08 situation that removes a Sim from university housing: a baby, a late pregnancy, or a Sim not enrolled, suspended or dropped out. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **HSExit**: The EP12 ways out of high school: graduation, early graduation, dropping out or the GED. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **HSV colour-grade set**: A client Renderer.HsvTweakerSettings record of colour-grading keys at fractional hours of the day. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **hysteresis band**: The overlap between neighbouring stat-backed ranges that keeps a state from flipping back at the same number. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
## I

- **icy conditions**: The SNOW_ICINESS channel (EP10): icy ground after snow on summit regions, at Freezing or Cold, for up to 3 Sim days. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **identical twins**: Babies after the first that copy the previous baby's sex and genetics (MONOZYGOTIC_OFFSPRING_CHANCE). ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **idle element**: What a Sim with no work runs: a short idle that sleeps up to 10 Sim minutes, or 1 when the interaction queue says it has more. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **imaginary friend**: An EP20 companion Sim tied to a child and visible only while that child is the active Sim. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **img://thumbs address**: A text pattern the server fills with ids and letters to tell the client which composite picture to draw. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **immediate super interaction**: A super interaction that runs at once with no walk or posture change. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **imposter interaction**: A super interaction that keeps the name and icon of the one it stands in for ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **in sunlight**: A Sim who is outside and not in shade while the sun is out (TimeService.is_in_sunlight). ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **in-progress object**: The unfinished object (ICO) that a phase places on the counter, easel or station, which holds the crafting process so the craft can be resumed. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **inactive apartment door**: A door to another unit in a plex building, owned by that unit's household, given portal cost 9999 and a system lock that only its unit's household passes. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md), [2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **inactive-zone injection**: Writing a Sim's location as another zone without loading it, so the Sim is there when that zone next loads. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **INAME**: The attribute name a component is stored under on its owner, such as `state_component`; reading a missing one returns None. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **incest threshold**: The rule that two Sims whose closest common ancestor is 5 or fewer generations away in total cannot have romance or children together. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **incremental GC**: The game's extended Python collector that can collect in bounded passes (collect_incremental) with per-pass root, node and traversal limits. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **incremental posture graph rebuild**: Updating the posture graph object by object during build mode instead of rebuilding it whole on exit. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **incremental start**: A service start that is spread over several native init ticks, used by the tuning loader. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **index**: The table at the start or end of a package that lists every resource's key, offset, sizes and compression. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **index flags**: The first word of a package index: bits 1, 2 and 4 mark the type, the group or the instance high word as stored once for all entries (saves use 2, a shared group). ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md), [8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **indexed manager**: A service that keeps objects of one kind by id and gives new ones an id from native _guid. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **inertial**: A super interaction that has delivered its content and now only holds its posture; anything may displace it. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **infant attachment**: The infant statistic (commodity_Infant_Attachment) that decides the infant reward trait at the toddler age-up. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **Inferred**: The book's label for a conclusion drawn from observed facts without seeing the deciding step, usually because it is native code or a module that did not decompile. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **influence**: The InfluenceBuck bucks currency spent on community board votes and on starting a repeal. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **ingredient quality bonus**: The average quality points of the ingredients used, from IngredientTuning.INGREDIENT_QUALITY_MAPPING (spoiled -550 in the live delta, pristine +60). ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **init-critical service**: A global service started at once during server init; the others start one per native init tick. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **initial depreciation**: The one-time 20 percent cut to an object's value applied at the post-build/buy fixup for the active household's objects. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **initial narrative**: A narrative listed in INITIAL_NARRATIVES and created on zone load if not active or completed, without its start step. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **`INITIAL_DEPRECIATION`**: The single 20 percent cut to an object's base value at the first post-build/buy fixup for the active household. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **insatiable hunger**: commodity_WerewolfCreation_InsatiableHunger, the second turning stage; at 0 the Sim turns. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **insert strategy**: Where a new interaction goes in its bucket: LAST (end), NEXT (after the running one) or FIRST (front). ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **instance id**: The 64-bit part of a resource key that tells resources of one type apart; for a tuning record it is either assigned by EA's tools or the FNV-1 64 hash of the lower-cased name. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **instance manager**: The per-type object that creates, stores and looks up every record of one tuning type. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **instance tuning**: Many records of one type (buffs, interactions, careers), each with its own instance id and Python class. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **instance tuning type**: One kind of tuning resource with its own manager, such as interaction or buff; 117 exist. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **instanced class manager**: One of 15 instance managers whose records become blueprint objects instead of Python classes. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **instanced Sim**: A Sim currently loaded as an object in the active zone, as opposed to one that exists only as data. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **instructed class**: A taught class situation whose pre-class state waits for both its timer and the instructor, then adds NPC members. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **insurance claim**: The sum of covered value losses times the claim percentage while a fire burns, paid when the last fire ends. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **intensity threshold**: A weight a mood must reach for its next step, for example 3 and 7 for Angry. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **INTERACTED LOD**: Level 50, given to a Sim who interacted with an active Sim; keeps sentiments and the few INTERACTED-only skills. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **interacted Sims list**: The culling service's saved map of Sim id to the last time that Sim interacted with an active Sim; it orders which INTERACTED Sims are demoted first. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **interaction**: One action a Sim performs, created from an affordance and a target and run through the Sim's interaction queue. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **interaction compatibility**: Whether two supers can run together: linked affordance filters, no cancel-AOP tie and intersecting constraints. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **interaction context**: The record pushed with an interaction: actor, source, priority, run priority, insert strategy, must-run-next flag, continuation and group ids. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **Interaction picker**: A picker interaction whose rows are other interactions; choosing a row pushes that row's continuation. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **interaction priority**: Low, High or Critical (SubLow below them); a newcomer displaces an existing interaction only with a higher priority, or an equal one when the old one is interruptible. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **interaction queue**: The per-Sim queue of pending interactions, made of six ordered buckets plus the running interaction. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **interaction source**: Where an interaction came from (pie menu, autonomy, script, posture graph, social adjustment, cancel replacements and others); it decides the queue bucket. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **interning**: Sharing one object for equal values while tuning loads, to save memory. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **interval decay**: Decay rates that change by band of the current track value. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **interval decay rate**: A decay rate that replaces the base rate on one value range, so a commodity drains at different speeds in different bands. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **invite only**: A guest-list flag; when it is off the situation also files a fallback request for its default job. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **`is_downloaded`**: True for objects whose content source is GALLERY or LIBRARY. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
## J

- **jewelry tracker**: Per-Sim record (SP49) of which jewel is worn on which body part in which outfit. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **jig**: A temporary object or fixed set of footprints placed on the floor that reserves space for an interaction or a conversation and gives the Sims in it their exact relative marks, as in a two-Sim social or a group dance; some kinds also make the floor around them costly for others to cross. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md), [3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md), [4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **jig group**: A social group type (JigGroup) that places its two members on the marks of a jig instead of in a free circle. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **join interaction**: The run-time "[Join]" interaction a Sim uses to join another Sim's joinable interaction ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **Journal**: The distributor's per-tick queue of finished operations, in the order they were added. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
## K

- **key table**: The list of 16-byte resource keys at the end of a CASP or SIMINFO; fields inside the resource point at it by one-byte index. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **kingdom**: The EP21 (Royalty & Legacy) record, per neighbourhood, of its noble Sims with their level, priority and heir, plus its decrees, tax level and custom titles. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **kingdom priority**: A noble's place in the ruling family: primary (title holder), secondary or tertiary, computed by the engine library. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **klout**: A request's importance for the soft cap: priority times 4, plus 1 if not elevated, plus 2 if not user facing; lower wins. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **knowledge trait type**: A trait type (likes, dislikes, aspiration, gameplay, lifestyle and others) whose traits the rest of the household learns the moment a Sim gains one. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
## L

- **landing strip**: The spot Sims are sent to when the lot is cleared or a blueprint is applied. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **landlord**: EP03 NPC found or created from LANDLORD_FILTER and linked to apartment households by rel bits. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **`lastException.txt`**: An exception report file named in the client strings; in the scripts Logger.exception writes a desync-type XML report through native _trace.log_exception. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **leak node**: The tracker's record of one removed object, in state PENDING, LEAKED or FALSE_POSITIVE. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **leave now must run**: The single-Sim leave situation used when an NPC must go at once, for example over the soft cap or when fired. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **leave situation**: The system situation (situation_leave) that walks NPCs off the lot. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **lesson**: A TUTORIAL instance shown in the Lessons panel: slides of text and images, grouped into categories and subcategories. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **liability**: An object attached to an interaction from queue time that runs code when it is added, run, transferred or released. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **life extension**: A loot (LifeExtensionLootOp) that adds bonus days and can rewind, reset, extend or fill the age bar. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **life stage**: One of the eight human ages: baby, infant, toddler, child, teen, young adult, adult, elder. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **lifespan setting**: The game option that picks the short, normal or long length of every life stage (AgeSpeeds FAST, NORMAL, SLOW). ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **lifestyle**: A trait earned by behaviour over days, tracked by a TraitStatistic; the lifestyle traits are not installed here. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **lifestyle brand**: Fame perk business paying daily by days active on a per-market, per-product curve. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **light dimmer**: A light's level from 0 to 1, with -1 meaning automatic; mirrored times 100 on the light statistic. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **Light effect**: A visual effect tuned on a light's lighting component; it runs while the light is on and is flagged auto-on when the light follows the automatic setting. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **light retail**: Small business sales of objects from a light retail surface, where the business keeps only the markup part of the price. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **lightning strike**: LightningStrike: a strike on terrain, an object or a Sim chosen by weights, with scorch marks, effects and created objects. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **LimitDirectManip**: Per-slider cap for dragging on the face or body in Create a Sim. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **LimitRandomize**: Per-slider cap used by the randomizer. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **`linked_stat`**: The statistic a stat-backed state reads its value from and writes its value back to. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **listener seed**: A listener waiting for a statistic that has no instance yet, held by the tracker and attached as soon as the statistic is added. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **litter size**: The number of babies from one pregnancy: one, two or three, rolled at delivery. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **Live command**: A command anyone can run at any time; most are callbacks the client UI sends to the server. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **live count**: The number of distinct resource keys a type has once full and delta builds are merged by key and deletion markers removed. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **live event**: A named switch (LiveEventName) whose state the client reports; activating one can schedule a drama node. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **live event quest**: A LiveEventQuest pivotal moment tied to a live event; covered in 4.05. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **live festival**: A live event of type LIVE_FESTIVAL with festival data (dates, street, lot, time); SoM2021 is the only one. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **live tuning**: The record set running in this install: the base delta build, then each installed pack's delta build, keyed by record type and id, a later record replacing an earlier one whole; 72,956 instance records here. The full builds share their resource key with the deltas and are not used. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **LiveEventQuest**: A PivotalMoment subclass for live-event quests: account persistence, always enabled, unkillable, its own cap of 2. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **loading monotonic time**: A tick counter that grows only during hitting their marks and is added to the game ticks to give monotonic time, so animation keeps moving while world time is held. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **locale code**: A code such as ENG_US that names a language; it appears in the Strings_<locale>.package file name. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **localization token**: One value passed into a string: a Sim, another string, raw text, a number, an object or a list of Sims. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **LocalizedString**: A 32-bit string key plus typed tokens; the client looks the key up in the string tables and fills the tokens in. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **LocalWork**: A non-shipping folder of loose resource files that EA's own tests mount at priority 1. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **lock action**: What locking a statistic does to its value (leave it, or set it to the minimum, maximum or best value); a lock also turns decay off. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **lock priority**: The rank of a portal lock (player 0, system 1, override player 2) used to resolve conflicting locks. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **locked enum**: A dynamic enum whose values must be unique and are kept regardless of installed packs. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **lockout**: A per-Sim block on using an object autonomously for a time, set when a push fails (15 Sim minutes live). ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **LOD**: Level of detail: a part lists up to four mesh levels, 0 the most detailed. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **loose tuning**: A tuning resource stored as its own entry in some package (the usual form of a tuning mod), preferred over the combined copy of the same key. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **loose tuning file**: A single tuning record shipped as its own text XML resource, as mods do; overrides the combined copy by key. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **loot action**: A LootActions instance: loot-level tests, run_test_first and a list of loot ops. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **loot op**: One entry of a loot action (a BaseLootOperation): subject, target, tests, subject filter tests and a chance. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **lossy repeating alarm**: A repeating alarm that schedules its next run one interval after the frame's target time, so intervals missed during a slow frame are skipped instead of fired one by one. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **lot**: The buildable area of a zone; in Python a native lot object extended with per-floor statistics, inventories and a default position. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **lot challenge**: A zone modifier shown in the lot challenge slot of the lot info panel. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **lot decoration**: A catalog trim placed at one of six locations on a lot (foundations, eaves, friezes, fences, spandrels, columns). ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **lot footprint**: The commodity_EcoFootprint_Lot score of one lot, moved by object state modifiers and one-shot loots. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **lot level**: Per-floor statistic container of a lot. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **lot pictures**: Types 0x0000000F (256 x 256 JPEG) and 0x00000010 (usually 400 x 400 JPEG; one sample was 499 x 499), present for zones saved at least once while loaded. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **Lot statistic modifier**: A rate an object state adds to a lot statistic such as the power or water meter while the state lasts; how objects use utilities. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **lot trait**: Player-facing name of a zone modifier shown through a lot-trait display info. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **lot tuning**: Per lot, street or region record holding walkbys, audio stings and premade status tracking. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **lottery holiday**: The EP05 Surprise Lottery drama node: ticket buyers plus filler Sims, a weighted draw, a 1,000,000 Simoleon payout. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **low-level simulation**: The mode for a Sim who is not instantiated, where a commodity keeps decaying only if its off-lot setting allows it. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **LRLE**: Texture type 0x2BC04EDF: packed image format used for skin tone layers. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **luck impact**: Case where the luck pick differs from the normal pick and is perceived better; shows a notification and effect. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **LuckLevel**: Band of the luck statistic (Bad, Neutral, Good) with a perceived-value bias, impact loot and enter loot. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **LuckService**: EP19 service that makes a second, luck-weighted pick among weighted options and reports when luck changed the outcome. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **LuckTracker**: EP19 per-Sim tracker that rolls luck daily, applies charm modifiers and runs the level's enter loot. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **lunar cycle**: The base-game moon calendar of eight phases that advances once a day at the phase change time. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **lunar effect**: A tuning instance that gives buffs (or, unused, runs one-shot operations) at a set hour of a phase. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **lunar effect tracker**: Per-Sim record of which lunar effects, by start time, the Sim has already been offered. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **lunar phase**: One of the eight moon states, from new moon (0) to waning crescent (7), each a LunarPhase tuning instance. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **lunar phase aware component**: Object component that sets object states to match the current moon phase. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
## M

- **macro (EA)**: A function or class marked @macros.macro whose body EA's ModuleSuiteImporter inlines into callers when compiling from source; at run time the decorator does nothing. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **manager id**: The number naming the kind of object an operation addresses, from 0 (unmanaged) to 10 (travel group). ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **mandatory goal**: A phase goal that holds the phase open; the phase completes when no active mandatory goal is left. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **Manifested trait**: An additional_occult_traits entry given to full occults; it carries the needs, sun rules and powers. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **manual-save callback**: Code run after a successful save to a slot above 1 that is not the autosave slot; the autosave service uses it to restart its countdowns. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **markup**: The price multiplier the owner picks from the business's tuned list; it scales every sale. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **master controller**: The scheduler that hands each Sim its next piece of work, ordered by interaction priority and then by how long the Sim has waited. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **master zone**: The zone that represents the whole plex building; venue lookups use it. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **masterwork**: A crafted object in the masterwork state, reached by a roll at the end of the craft or, for Perfectionists, by a step up from outstanding; it raises the item's value. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **`max_selectable`**: The picker rule for how many rows may be chosen: a fixed count, unlimited, all but one, free household slots, and other variants. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **`MAXIMUM_SAFE_FITNESS_VALUE`**: The cap on the fitness a Sim's fit commodity converges to; 40 in live tuning (code default 90), so CAS fitness above 40 drifts down. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md), [3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **MaxProtectedSims**: A client option with counts 80, 150, 200 or unlimited, set from hardware in the rule files; no Python reads it. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **meaningful relationship**: A relationship whose bits, from one Sim's side, include one of the 12 MEANINGFUL_RELATIONSHIP_BITS (friend, good friends, BFF and variants, five romantic combos); counted by get_relationship_metrics. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **medal level**: One of tin, bronze, silver and gold; each adds a score delta, and a situation's medal is the highest whose cumulative threshold its score reaches. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **medal payout**: The performance and money multipliers given for a tin, bronze, silver or gold score. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **meet and greet**: Player-hosted EP06 event that auto-fills fans by the celebrity's star rank. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **memory trigger**: A message sent to the client when an interaction starts and ends, used for memories. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **merit scholarship**: The scholarship valued by how many prestige degrees a Sim was accepted into, evaluated at enrolment. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **milestone**: The base of aspirations and achievements: a set of objectives with complete-all or complete-subset rules. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **`min_lod_value`**: Tunable on traits and statistics: the lowest Sim info LOD at which that trait or statistic is kept (default BACKGROUND). ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **minimized situation**: A pivotal moment waiting in the UI strip with status DELAYED (op 1278) until the player opens it or a re-check starts it. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **MINIMUM LOD**: Level 1, a one-way family-tree stub: no relationships, statistics or buffs, cannot be spawned, does not age, and counts as dead to SimInfo.is_dead. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **minimum route distance**: Vehicle setting: the path must be longer than this for the Sim to deploy the vehicle. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **Missing pet tracker**: The household tracker that tests pets every hour, sends a neglected or disliked pet away, and brings it back later. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **Missing-pet alert**: A computer or phone action that shortens the remaining time until a missing pet returns by 60 to 75 percent, once per absence. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **mixer**: A short interaction that runs inside a running super interaction, such as changing the channel while watching TV; in crafting, the chops, stirs and flourishes played inside a phase, some with loot that moves the process quality. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md), [6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **mixer group**: A category of mixers (DEFAULT, IDLES) drawn by tuned weight before the mixers inside it are scored. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **mixer lockout**: A per-Sim timer set when a mixer runs that keeps the Sim from choosing that mixer again for a while. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **mixer provider**: A running interaction or a buff that offers mixers to subaction autonomy, scored by urgency and weight. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **mobile posture**: A posture a Sim can walk in, such as stand or swim; routes always run through one. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **modal dialog**: In the service's sense, any stored dialog that is not a notification and does not ring; while one is open, player-planned events reschedule themselves. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **Mods folder**: The user folder whose default config mounts mod packages up to five folders deep at priority 500. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **modular piece**: One piece of a modular object; its parts depend on which neighbours it has. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **module tuning**: One tuning record per Python module that sets that module's class-level constants and enums; resource type tun (0x03B33DDF), keyed by FNV-1 64 of the module path with a hyphen. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **monozygotic**: An identical twin: a later baby that copies the previous baby's gender and genetics seed, 33.33% per baby in live tuning. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **mood**: The single emotion a Sim shows, one of 17 Mood instances, chosen by a weighted vote over the Sim's buffs. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood effect modifier**: A game effect that multiplies one or more moods' summed weights, for example x1.5 on most moods for teenagers. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood intensity**: The step of the active mood, 0 to 2: the count of the mood's intensity thresholds that its weight meets or exceeds. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood preference**: content_score.mood_preference: points added to a social's content score when the actor is in a listed mood. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood stickiness**: The _should_update_mood rule that keeps the active mood when a rival reaches the same step, at step 1 or higher. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood vote**: BuffComponent's rule that sums buff weights per mood, takes the heaviest mood of each polarity, then the heaviest leader; with no leader the mood is Mood_Fine. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **mood weight**: A buff's mood_weight: how many points it adds to its mood's total in the mood vote (most buffs weigh 1 or 2). ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **moodlet**: A buff the player sees in the emotion panel; hidden buffs work the same way but are not shown. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **moon forecast**: The list of upcoming daily moon phases the server sends to the calendar UI. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **MoonPhaseUpdate**: The server-to-client message carrying the current phase and the skip-environment-changes flag. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **motive band**: The group of needs scored in one pass: every need at or above 0.51 times the top need's urgency (live tuning). ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **multi picker**: A dialog that embeds several pickers and an optional text input and returns them all in one answer. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **multi-motive buff**: A buff added while several needs all sit at or above set thresholds and removed when any one falls below, such as All Motives High. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **multi-unit event**: An EP04 drama-driven event on a multi-unit lot whose outcome loot is shared by all nodes of that type on the unit. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **multi-unit rental**: EP15 building type whose units are rented to tenants and billed by the rental unit manager. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **multiple orders**: A phase setting that lets more orders join a craft already in progress; loop-by-orders phases repeat once per queued order. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **multitasking percentage**: The chance threshold a busy Sim must meet to start a new autonomous action: base from attention cost plus urgency bonus minus penalty. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **multitasking roll**: A random number in [0, 1) per Sim, kept until its activity list changes, compared with the multitasking percentage. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **must run next**: A flag on posture-graph transition interactions that forces them to run directly after the current one. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **must-run time**: The part of an arb that has to play before anything else may start; the server sleeps for it. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **mutex**: A keyed first-in, first-out lock for elements, used by posture transitions. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
## N

- **name map**: A small resource (type 0x0166038C) that maps instance ids to names; the shipped ones name only build leftovers. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **narrative**: A game-wide story state, grouped so that starting one ends the others in its group. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **narrative group**: A tag shared by narratives that exclude each other, such as WerewolfPack_AllianceFeud. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **narrative threshold link**: A progression rule that moves to another narrative when an event counter leaves its interval. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **native component**: A component listed by id in the OBJD catalog entry; only Footprint, LiveDrag, Slot and Video have a server-side class. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **native module**: A Python module written in C++ inside Simulation_x64.dll, named with a leading underscore (_zone, _buildbuy, _pathing); the scripts import it and fall back to a stub outside the game. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **navmesh fence**: A marker added to the path planner when build mode ends; the gameplay exit hooks run when the engine reports the fence back. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **`needs_fitness_update`**: Sim attribute set on a band change and cleared by update_fitness_state, so the body updates once per change. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **Neighborhood Action Plan**: The in-game name (string 0xEA344460) for a street civic policy voted on at the community board. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **neutral bit**: The bit a track shows when no threshold node applies; for a sentiment, the bit present while it exists. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **No-medal placement**: The last placement of a horse competition; its weight is a flat constant per tier. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **`no_op_version`**: A counter stored on portrait objects and passed to and from the client with each composite request. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **`no_show_action`**: A job setting for a tardy request: END_SITUATION, REPLACE_THEM or DO_NOTHING. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **noble career**: career_Noble (EP21), the career whose level is a Sim's rank in its neighbourhood's kingdom. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **NoOpinion trait**: A hidden trait added when the player declines a discovered preference, so the game does not ask again. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **normals map**: The DMAP of a pair that holds normal changes, -0.75 to +0.75 per axis. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **notebook entry**: An item in a Sim's notebook (plants, bait, recipes, secrets and others), stored per subcategory and shown in the notebook view. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **`notify_image_composited`**: Live command the client sends back with the resource key of a finished composite image. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **Nowhere**: The empty constraint: no place satisfies it. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **NPC leave interaction**: The interaction that walks a visiting Sim to the lot edge and off the lot, then shows a goodbye notification when it was a motive failure. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **NPC order weights**: The restaurant table of recipe tags and tests that weights which dish an NPC diner picks from the menu. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **NPC soft cap**: NPC_SOFT_CAP 20 minus a modifier minus the active household size; at or above it only game breakers and selectable Sims spawn. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **NPC summoning purpose**: Enum naming why an NPC is being brought to a lot (invite over, stay the night, zone fixup and others); venues map each to a behaviour. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **NPC-hosted situation**: An event an NPC runs and the player is invited to or visited by, such as the welcome wagon or an NPC birthday party. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
## O

- **object definition (OBJD)**: The package record behind a catalog object: name, tuning id, model, rig, slots, footprint, components and price. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **object id**: The 64-bit id native _guid assigns to an object, Sim or other managed record. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **object knowledge**: A record that a Sim knows a specific object with a given tag, kept in the global Sim-object relationship service. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **object leak tracker**: An optional tool that records objects removed from managers and reports those still alive after 2 full GC passes and 3 Sim hours. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **object part**: One Sim-usable spot of a multi-Sim object (a seat, a bed side); a Part proxies its owner but has its own location, slots and reservations ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **object routing**: The system that lets objects (robots, toys) route on their own. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **object routing soft cap**: How many objects may route at once: the NPC cap minus the Sims on the lot plus a threshold, at least 1; only CRITICAL behaviours bypass it. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **object score**: An automation-only per-definition cost estimate built from component counts and fixed weights, shown as a percentage of 0.007. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **object situation shifts**: Situation shifts tied to an object tag: a zone director or an object's scheduler component staffs each tagged object, scaling the desired Sim count by the number of objects up to a cap. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **object state**: A named track of mutually exclusive values on an object, such as Broken or Dirty, held by the state component. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **object-based situation schedule**: The deprecated weekly schedule hung on tagged objects through a situation scheduler component; each entry starts one situation on the object. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **`object_fallbacks`**: SaveGameData field 11: pairs of object guid and fallback guid. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **ObjectData**: One saved object: ids, placement, appearance, cost, flags, and the attributes blob. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **objective**: An Objective instance: an objective test, extra tests, a completion type and completion loot. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **ObjectLODBias**: A graphics rule value per object quality tier (4.0, 1.0, 0.6666) that biases object mesh detail selection. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **ObjectPart**: The tuning record (object_part) a part entry names: supported postures, affordance filter, blacklisted buffs, trait tests, subroot, surface ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **Observed**: The book's label for a claim read directly in decompiled code, tuning or file bytes, with the source named so a reader can check it. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **obstacle course**: An EP04 coach-and-pet situation in which autonomy picks each next obstacle until none is left, then failures are counted. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **occult**: A supernatural kind of Sim (vampire, werewolf, mermaid, spellcaster, alien, fairy), stored as a flag in the Sim's occult types. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **occult form**: One stored appearance and outfit set per occult type, kept in the occult tracker's form map and swapped in on a switch. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **occult trait**: The trait whose presence makes a Sim own an occult type (for example trait_OccultVampire). ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **`OCCULT_DATA`**: Module tuning map from occult type to its traits, experience statistic, outfit rules and CAS options. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **OccultType**: The IntFlags enum of occult kinds: HUMAN 1, ALIEN 2, VAMPIRE 4, MERMAID 8, WITCH 16, WEREWOLF 32, FAIRY 64. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **ocean data**: Per species and age tuning (OceanTuning.OCEAN_DATA) that sets how deep a Sim may wade in the sea, whether it can swim there, and when it changes into swimwear. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **off-lot autonomy rule**: The rule that decides which objects outside the active lot a Sim may use (DEFAULT, ON_LOT_ONLY, UNLIMITED, ANCHORED and others). ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **off-lot simulation**: The every-4-hours estimate of customers, profit and rating change for a player business that is open while the household is elsewhere. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **off-lot tolerance**: How far outside the active lot, in metres, a Sim or object still counts as on it for autonomy; 7.5 m in tuning. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **old-age death**: The death interaction pushed when an elder's age bar runs out (Death_OldAge_TestLocation for humans). ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **omega**: The Python wrapper over native _omega.send, which delivers serialized messages to the client session. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **on_enter broadcaster**: A broadcaster frequency that applies once per object for the broadcaster's lifetime, or again after each re-entry with allow_multiple. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **ONBOARDING property**: ScenarioProperties flag carried by the three Welcome scenarios. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **onboarding requirement**: A pivotal moment flag (is_onboarding_requirement); such moments start once guidance allows, and the others wait until they are all done. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **one-shot effect**: An effect started with start_one_shot that the server never stops. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **Op**: A Python object that writes one distributor operation (a typed protobuf payload) for one object. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **open street director**: Per-street manager that loads and removes object layers on a schedule, runs lot cleanup and summons NPCs on the open street. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **open street director request**: A request to make a director active on the street, ranked by priority (DEFAULT, CART, FESTIVAL). ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **open-street autonomy situation**: An NPC situation in which one Sim runs free autonomy on the open street for a set time and then leaves. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **operation**: The protobuf message an Op writes: a type out of 444, the serialized payload and its channels. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **opportunity cost**: The current value of activities a new choice would cancel, subtracted from its score. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **optimistic score**: A score computed with no walk, no posture change and no opportunity cost, used to drop affordances before a path query. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **OptionalTargetParam**: An argument holding an object id; empty means the active Sim, and -1 to -4 mean the active lot, region, street and venue. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **OptionalTunable**: A variant with the options disabled and enabled, giving either None or a value. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **organization**: A university society (EP08 Discover University) with a ranked progress statistic, member tasks and scheduled events. ([4.03](4.03-groups-factions.md))
- **organization event**: A drama node that schedules an organization's weekly meeting at a venue or as a festival-style event. ([4.03](4.03-groups-factions.md))
- **organization task**: A timed aspiration assigned to an active member of an organization; three at a time. ([4.03](4.03-groups-factions.md))
- **orphaned record**: A first, unindexed copy of the main record (and a stale index) left inside manual slot files. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **outcome**: The part of an interaction that decides which actions and loot run: none, single, dual, test based or partial. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **outcome actions**: The animations, loot_list, events_to_send and continuations run for a chosen outcome. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **outcome block**: A tested set of weighted outcomes on a social; all passing blocks join the draw, and the fallback runs only if none pass. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **outdoor autonomy penalty**: The factor (1 minus penalty times trait reductions) that rain or snow applies to outdoor objects in autonomy scoring. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **outfit**: One set of CAS parts a Sim can wear, stored as parallel lists of part ids and body types under an outfit category and index. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **outfit category**: The kind of situation an outfit is for (OutfitCategory): EVERYDAY 0 to SMALL_BUSINESS 13, plus CURRENT_OUTFIT -1. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **outfit change fixup**: One of three steps that may override a resolved clothing change, in order: weather, career, small business. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **outfit index**: The position of an outfit inside its category; most categories hold up to 5, BATHING and SITUATION 1, CAREER and SPECIAL 3. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **outfit provider**: The object that picks an index within a category; the default RandomOutfitProvider picks a random index other than its last pick. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **OutfitChangeReason**: Why a Sim changes clothes; 7 reasons are hard-coded and 36 are tuned, and each tuned reason maps to an ordered list of (tests, category) entries. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **OutfitFilterFlag**: Bit flags that steer native outfit generation, such as USE_EXISTING_IF_APPROPRIATE, MATCH_ALL_TAGS and FORCE_FULLBODY. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **OutfitGenerator**: A tuning snippet that tells native generation which tags a generated outfit's parts must have and must not have, with per-body-type chances. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **overlapping parts**: The parts a part's reservation needs free for the same Sim; how a Sim on one side of a bed blocks the spots on that side ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **overmax**
  1. Careers: extra levels past the last level of a track, each adding salary and raising the promotion threshold. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
  2. Occult ranks: a repeating last experience level whose loot gives points and subtracts experience so it can be reached again. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
## P

- **pack**: One installable content set, identified in code by a Pack value such as EP09 or GP12; 142 values exist. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
