- **pack gate**: The pack argument of the decorator; the command registers only if one of the named packs is available when the module is imported. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **pack hot-load**: Loading or unloading a pack's tuning while the game runs, re-reading only that pack's records and the records that reference them. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **pack id**: The code the game uses for a pack: EP for expansion packs, GP for game packs, SP for stuff packs, FP for the free pack; the UI tuning lists 118 ids with the base game. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **pack safe**: A reference that may point at a record from a pack the player lacks; a missing target drops the enclosing list entry or becomes None. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **pack safe reference**: A tuning reference that loads as empty when its target's pack is not installed. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **package**: A .package file: a DBPF container of numbered resources. The game's content, its patches and its saves all use it. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **packed XML**: The binary form of a combined tuning tree: node, attribute and string tables inside a SimData container. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **painting style**: A PaintingStyle record: a weighted list of painting textures a canvas can show. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **painting texture**: A PaintingTexture record: one picture resource with the canvas types and tests it applies to. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **paparazzi shift**: Situation curve on each fan-supporting zone director with slots at 8, 12, 16 and 20 h, scaled by star rating and region. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **parameterized autonomy**: An autonomy request an interaction makes for itself ("find something that solves X"), run as a script request that ignores the player's autonomy setting. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **part group index**: A part's index: its key's position in the sorted _part_data_map (after any old _part_data entries) ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **part occult**: A Sim with an occult parent's look but not the occult type; only ALIEN tunes a part-occult trait. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **PartGenderDmaps**: Client_CASModifierPartGenderDmaps records that swap the chest maps when a Sim wears a top or full-body part made for the other gender frame. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **participant type**: A ParticipantType flag (175 of them) naming a role such as Actor, TargetSim, Object or Lot. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **partitioned enum**: A dynamic enum whose values are split into blocks of 2048 per pack above 8192. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **passive balloon**: A balloon a walking Sim may show on its own, limited by a lockout of 240 plus 0 to 60 Sim minutes. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **patch data**: Tuning and files in the Delta folder of a pack this install does not have: EA re-ships them in patches, in the same format as live tuning, but the game never loads them. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md), [8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **patch data, pack not installed**: The book's label for tuning from the Delta folder of a pack this install does not have; cited to describe the pack, never counted as live. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **path obstacle**: A jungle object blocking a route; some are always clearable, a random few more are clearable for each travel group, the rest stay blocked. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **path spec**: The chosen chain of posture changes with its routes; its total cost is the path cost plus the route length. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **payroll**: The record of each employee's clocked hours per career level, used to compute the day's wages and cleared at close. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **pelt layer**: A pet coat layer: a layer id and a colour, stored on the Sim. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **penthouse**: A plex building type with one unit; counted as an apartment unless a test excludes penthouses. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **per-function rescue**: Decompiling each function of a failed module separately, so that only the functions the decompiler cannot handle stay unread. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **perceived value bias**: Factor a luck level multiplies an option's player_perception by before luck weights are built (Bad -1, Good 2). ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **Perfectionist**: A trait whose in-the-zone buff gives a 1 in 9 chance at the end of a craft to step the item up one tier, outstanding to masterwork included. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **performance counter**: A named native counter (for example the autonomy queue length) that Python sets or increments through _perf_api. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **performance tick**: The 30-minute update that adds a share of the level's per-shift performance. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **periodic skill gain**: A skill gain applied as a rate in points per Sim minute while an interaction runs. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **perk**: A BucksPerk record bought with one bucks type; it can give buffs, traits, rewards and loots and can be temporary. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **Perk picker**: An interaction (BucksPerkPickerSuperInteraction) that lists the locked perks of one bucks type to buy, or the unlocked ones to remove with a refund. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **permanently disabled CTA**: A call to action aborted with the permanent flag; its guid is saved in the save slot and begin ignores it afterwards. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **persistable region**: A region with is_persistable set; only these get a saved instance in the region service. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **persistable trait**: A trait that is saved and survives travel; 55 live traits turn it off and vanish on both. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **PersistableData**: One component's saved data: a DATA_TYPE value plus the component message as a protobuf extension numbered 21001 to 21077. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **persisted LOD**: The level of detail written with a Sim; ACTIVE is stored as FULL. A MINIMUM Sim keeps its full SimData, but its attributes shrink to occult, death and genealogy, and inventory, outfit index, mood, location and interactions are dropped. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **persistence option**
  1. Situations: the custom states field that chooses how a situation is saved (DONT, LOT, OPEN_STREETS, pivotal moment levels). ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
  2. Pivotal moments: where a completion is kept, GAME (once per install, client-stored), ACCOUNT (account data) or HOUSEHOLD (the household save). ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **PersistenceGroups**: Object groups for saving: NONE 0, OBJECT 1 (lot list), SIM 2 (never saved as an object), IN_OPEN_STREET 3 (street list). ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **PersistenceMaster**: The attributes blob of an object or Sim: a list of PersistableData entries, one per component or tracker. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **PersistenceOpType**: Native persistence operations: Load 1, Save 2, LoadZoneObjects 3, SaveZoneObjects 4, the two gameplay global data ops 5 and 6, SaveHousehold 1000. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **`persists_across_gallery`**: Object state flag; when False the state returns to its default on a downloaded object. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **personality trait**: A trait of type PERSONALITY, the kind chosen in Create a Sim; the number of slots comes from AGING_DATA per age. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **Personality urge**: A hidden commodity per pet personality trait (commodity_Trait_Pet_*) that drives the trait's autonomous behaviours. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **pet adoption visit**: An EP04 situation in which an officer brings a crate, pet candidates spawn in front of it, and the officer leaves after they despawn. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **Pet habit (misbehaviour trait)**: A hidden trait such as trait_Misbehavior_Cat_Scratching that lets a pet perform one kind of misbehaviour until it is trained out. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **Pet illness**: A Sickness record for cats and dogs (for example Common Lava Nose) with symptoms, correct treatments and diagnosis thresholds. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **phase**: One step of a recipe (SimplePhase or MultiStagePhase) with its own interaction, turn count or progress bar, and links to the next phases. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **phase change time**: The hour at which the daily moon check runs and phases change (PHASE_CHANGE_TIME_OF_DAY, 7). ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **phase interaction**: The super-interaction that runs one recipe phase; its class decides whether it creates, places, carries or transfers the object. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **phase lock**: The option that holds the moon on one phase; it takes effect at the next phase change time. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **phase output**: A pairing of scenario tests with either a next phase or a scenario outcome, plus output loot; the first passing output wins. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **phase scenario**: A scenario with a starting_phase; it runs one ScenarioPhase at a time and moves on through tested outputs. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **phone ring type**: How a dialog arrives: NO_RING (a plain pop-up), BUZZ, RING, ALARM or PIVOTAL_MOMENT (a call on the phone, which also sets normal game speed). ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **physique**: A string of nine comma-separated floats on the Sim record, indexed by BodyBlendTypes: the four body numbers heavy, fit, lean and bony, plus pregnancy and the hip and waist slots. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md), [3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **physique byte**: Byte 20 of a DMAP header: 0 to 4 marks the Heavy, Fit, Lean, Bony and Pregnant maps, 9 an ordinary map. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **physique reaction**: One of eight fat_change_* or fit_change_* interactions pushed on a band change; its update_physique extra rewrites the physique. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **picker**: A dialog that lists rows to choose from (Sims, objects, recipes, outfits, lots); its interaction ends when the list is shown and the choice arrives later. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **picker interaction**: An interaction that shows a list of Sims, objects, items or states and pushes a continuation for the chosen ones. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **picker row**: One entry in a picker: an option id, a tag (the thing returned), enabled flag, name, icon, description and tooltip. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **pipeline progress**: An interaction's stage: NONE, QUEUED, PRE_TRANSITIONING, PREPARED, RUNNING, STAGED, EXITED. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **pivotal moment**: A guided quest (snippet PivotalMoment, shown to players as a Discovery Quest) that listens for triggers, then starts a PivotalMomentSituation with a reward. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **placeholder statistic**: A tracker entry stored as empty for a statistic at its default with nothing acting on it, turned into a real instance when something reads or changes it. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **placement**: One possible result of a competition (gold, silver, bronze or no medal) with its prize money and weight; its index is the number of placements minus rounds won minus 1, so lower is better. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md), [4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **placement flags**: A 32-bit word per object definition, read from the engine, saying how the object attaches (wall, ceiling, roof, slot, terrain, water). ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **placement strategy**: A tuned rule (location, slot, inventory or household inventory) that says where a script-created object goes. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **PlacementHelper**: A tuned list of weighted placement strategy groups tried in order until one places the object. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **plant constant**: The per-plant `GardeningDecay_PlantDecays` modifiers that scale growth, moisture, bugs and weeds for that plant type. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **plant health**: The `PlantStatusAggregate` state: Bad when any care meter is red, Good when none is red or yellow, otherwise unchanged; Neutral only at planting. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **plant quality**: The `GardeningQuality` state: Wild, Sickly, Frail, Meager, Scrubby or Pristine; fruit inherits it and loses value by it. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **`play_tunable_audio`**: Helper that plays a TunablePlayAudio; with no owner given it plays on the first client's active Sim. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **played household**: A household the player has played; it is also flagged as a player household. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **played lot weight**: The curve that gives played lots 70 to 100 percent of the convergence weight once any lot is played. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **played travel group**: A travel group whose played flag is set (the player's own stays); only played groups count against a venue's travel group limit. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **PlayEffect**: The server's visual effect primitive; sends VFX_START (37) with an effect name, actor id and joint, and VFX_STOP (20) to end it. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **player days played**: The player experience level the client sets with live_events.set_days_played, capped at 100 in PlayerDayTest. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **player-directed interaction**: For responsiveness, a user-directed interaction on a selectable Sim; its worst time is kept apart from all others. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **`player_perception`**: Per-option value from -100 to 100 saying how good the outcome looks to the player; drives luck weighting. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **PlaySound**: The server's sound primitive; sends SOUND_START (36) on a per-sound channel and SOUND_STOP (18) to end it. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **playstyle**: A tuned enum of seven player types used to recommend scenarios. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **plex**
  1. A lot split into several zones (units) sharing one master zone and a common area. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
  2. A numbered sub-area of a lot that the engine can show or hide; temples use one plex per room. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **point of no return**: A phase flag: once a craft reaches that phase, cancelling its interaction still moves on to the next phase, so the product is always made. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **polarity**: BuffPolarity of a mood: NEGATIVE, POSITIVE or NEUTRAL (the default, used by Fine and Asleep); moods of one polarity compete, they never add. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **pool edge social**: A social interaction anchored at the edge of a pool or the ocean where the player clicked. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **pool seat**: A part of a swimming pool where a Sim sits on the edge. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **portal**: A link the route planner may cross that is not open floor: door, stairs, ladder, pool edge, elevator, teleport. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **portal locking component**: Per-Sim lock state of a door or other portal, with preset locks and both-side unlocks ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **portal traversal type**: How a Sim crosses a portal: walking through, an animation, a jump, stairs, a ladder, a posture change, an elevator or a teleport. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **possession source**: A tagged buff that keeps a StrangerVille infected Sim possessed; the longest-lasting source drives the possessed state. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **post-build/buy fixup**: Work queued for objects created in build mode and run on exit: a rebate record, the one-time depreciation and the ObjectAdd event. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **posture**: What a Sim's body is doing and what it is attached to: stand, sit, lie, swim, carry and so on. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture graph**: The graph of every posture spec a Sim could reach on the lot, with costed edges, searched to plan transitions. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture operation**: An edge of the posture graph: body transition, pick up, put down, put down on surface, target already in slot, forget surface. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture spec**: A node of the posture graph: a body aspect, a carry aspect and a surface aspect. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture state spec**: What a constraint asks of a Sim's pose: allowed postures, slot needs and a body target; constraints intersect it and the posture graph expands it into nodes. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture track**: One of a Sim's posture slots: body, left hand, right hand, back. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **posture transition target tag**: A tag on an object or part that lets an interaction prefer that kind of target in posture scoring; parts inherit their owner's tag. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **Potent Power**: Vampire perk line that lowers the Power cost of powers. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **Power**: Vampire energy, commodity_Motive_Visible_Vampire_Power, -100 to 100 with no passive decay. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **power points**: VampirePowerBucks earned by vampire experience levels and spent on power perks. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **pre-day**: The period before a holiday (default 23 hours) when pre-holiday buffs apply and the upcoming holiday shows. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **pre-festival period**: The Sim minutes between a festival's selected time and its start (pre_festival_duration). ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **pre-phase effect**: A lunar effect tuned on a phase that fires during the phase before it. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **`pre_save`**: Service hook run for every service of a tier before any of them saves; the object manager uses it to bring commodities up to date. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **preference**: A like or dislike: a Preference trait of type LIKE or DISLIKE pointing at an activity, colour or music genre. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **preference discovery**: The adventure moments during an activity that offer a new like (while Inspired) or dislike (while Angry). ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **preference group**: The CasPreferenceGroup that sets how many likes and dislikes a Sim can hold and how many Randomize must give. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **preferred Sim**: The service NPC a household last used, asked for first next time. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **pregnancy commodity**: The 0 to 100 statistic (commodity_Pregnancy) that tracks a pregnancy; trimester buffs come from its states and birth from reaching 100. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **pregnancy origin**: A tag on a pregnancy (DEFAULT, alien abduction, lighthouse, vampire bats and others) that can add traits at birth. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **pregnancy seed**: A number drawn at conception that fixes the dice for litter size, sex and genetics. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **preload**: A byte-identical copy of the delta build's combined tuning in SimulationPreload, with a higher package priority. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **preload package**: SimulationPreload: a higher-priority package holding a copy of most of the simulation delta (for the base game its tuning is byte-identical to the delta's), released by the Python once tuning has loaded. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **premade lot status**: Save flag that records whether a tracked lot is still the shipped premade build. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **premade Sim**: A Sim built from a PremadeSimTemplate and its .siminfo resource, then fixed up once at zone spin-up. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **PremadeSimFixupHelper**: The routine that, at zone spin-up, gives each new premade Sim its family, household, relationships, career, occult form and other template data in a fixed order. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **prep task**: A statistic to fill before a gig, often fed by a share of skill gains. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **preparation liability**: A liability with a step that runs before the Sim walks to the interaction, able to push other work first and derail. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **prepped ingredient**: An SP46 ingredient object that stands in for a group of raw ingredient requirements and can shorten cooking. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **preroll autonomy**: The PrerollAutonomy mode: one interaction per Sim when a lot loads, chosen without regard to distance. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **prescribed weather type**: Flags on a forecast or event (rain, storm, snow, blizzard, thunder_snow_storms) that let the player's weather options and the rain-after-snow rule remove it. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **preset lock**: A lock data entry tuned on an object, applied when the locking component is created ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **prestige degree**: A university major that needs an acceptance score; the count of prestige acceptances sets the merit scholarship's value. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **prevailing context**: The social-context track with the largest absolute value for a pair, or the group average used by social scoring. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **primary trait**: The bonus trait an aspiration track names, such as trait_High_Metabolism for Athletic. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **print channel**: How a console command reports back: cheat_output prints to the console, output is silent in retail, automation_output goes to the automation stream. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **priority**: The number in a Resource.cfg that orders mounted packages; a higher number answers first (Mods 500, delta -20, full -30). ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **privacy**: A tuned area around an interaction (toilet, shower) that shoos other Sims and blocks them while it runs. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **process quality**: The quality statistic on the crafting process itself (P), moved by station, dirt, mixer and trait loot during the phases and folded into the grade as (P + 50) x m - 50. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **production trace**: Native logging channel (_trace.prod_trace) used by ProductionLogger; one of the few log paths left active in the retail scripts. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **profanity filter**: The native word filter (scan and check, substitution character *) that Python applies to gallery names, engravings and crafter names. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **profile log group**: A --profile-log-group command-line value that turns a named logger into an always-on performance logger. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **prom royalty and jester**: The two EP12 prom titles, drawn by weight from vote counts times a skill-based multiplier. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **promised heir**: The Sim a noble has named to inherit its title (inheriting_sim_id); it carries trait_NobleCareer_Promised. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **prop override**: An entry in an object or interaction animation override that maps a prop name of the ASM to an object definition, so the same clip spawns a different prop. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **property tax**: The part of the bill worked out in brackets from the household's billable value; 1.8 to 4.9 percent per bracket live. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **PROPX**: Resource type 0x39B2AA4A named in tuning for a sound; its instance is FNV-1 64 of the lowercased file stem and is sent to the client as a sound id. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **protected and unprotected rule sets**: The two save-wide story progression rule sets, for player households and for all other households; a household without its own rules inherits one of them. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **protobuf descriptor**: A serialized FileDescriptorProto; 57 game ones are embedded in Simulation_x64.dll and give the exact save schema. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **prototype tuning**: Object tuning 15013, used when a catalog entry names no tuning or a missing one. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **provides sunlight**: Region flag; when False the sun is never out in that world, whatever the hour. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **proximity roll**: The weighted draw of a sentiment's effect when the two Sims are near, at most once per 125 Sim minutes. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **proxy interaction**: A run-time subclass wrapping another affordance under a "[Proxy]" name ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **PTO**: Paid time off: days off that count as a full shift. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **puddle**: A Puddle object of a liquid and size that dries by an evaporation commodity and can grow one size when fed. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **puddle liquid**: PuddleLiquid: WATER, Dark Matter, GreenGoo, Vomit, Mud or Acid, used with the size to choose a puddle definition. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **purchase intent**: A retail shopper's statistic whose value sets the chance of buying an item. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **Purchase picker category**: A tag-filtered tab of a shop picker; it is hidden when no row carries its tag unless it has a disabled tooltip. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **purgatory stage**: A waiting stage of the reset pipeline that holds a record until every record in the batch has caught up. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **put-down strategy**: The tuning that scores where a carried object may be put down: slot, floor, object inventory, Sim inventory. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
## Q

- **QA budgets**: The performance_constants.BUDGETS table of target counts (900 objects, 20 Sims, 3,000 posture nodes) printed next to live metrics. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **quality multiplier**: The factor m on process quality, collected from autonomy modifiers whose subject is CraftingProcess, such as station upgrades and fancy stoves. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **queue head**: The interaction the queue will process next: the first unblocked item of the first bucket that has one. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **quirk**
  1. A trait handed out from a quirk set on the species definition, at load and at each age change, drawn with a generator seeded by the Sim id; pets get fears, obsessions, sleep styles and starting habits this way. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md), [3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
  2. Fame quirk: a fame perk (such as No Touching or Paparazzi Darling) that unlocks through a progression statistic once quirk points are available. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **Quirk set**: A list on the pet's Sim definition from which a target number of quirks is drawn by weight, the number shifted by the pet's personality traits. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
## R

- **r reference**: An element that stands for a shared node: x gives the node's index and n the field name it fills. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **rabbit hole**: A place a Sim disappears into for a time, such as work or an outing: the hide-Sim liability fades the Sim, its carried Sims and leashed pets out of the world until the interaction ends. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md), [3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **rally**: Pushing one Sim's chosen interaction onto its whole group or ensemble. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **rampage**: The werewolf state entered at 499 Fury; it pushes the rampage transformation at Critical priority. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **random weighted loot**: A RandomWeightedLoot instance that picks one tested entry by weight and applies it. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **rank**: A count on a ranked statistic that rises by one at each level flagged rank_up; Fame stars are ranks. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **ranked statistic**: A continuous statistic split into event levels by tuned point intervals, with a rank that rises at flagged levels, loot on level changes and optional decay floors; Fame is the main example. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **RCOL**: A container format used by models, geometry, materials, lights, footprints and slots; it holds chunks with four-letter tags. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **RCOL wrapper**: Community name for the header shared by SMOD, SCLP, BGEO, BOND, RMAP and GEOM: five words, own key, external keys, chunk offset and size. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **real second**: A second of wall-clock time (TunableRealSecond), used for budgets, time slices, fades and cooldowns; it does not speed up with the game. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **real-time autosave**: Autosave by wall-clock interval (30, 60 or 120 real minutes by option). ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **rebate**: Money returned after a qualifying purchase or for qualifying objects, paid on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **recipe**: A RECIPE-manager instance that says what is made, at which station, from which phases, at what price and with which ingredients, quality rules and value rules. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **reference arb**: An object's latest post-condition arb, sent when the object is created on the client so it appears in its current pose. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **referrer graph**: A graphml file listing the objects that hold references to a leaked object, breadth first to depth 10. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **RefPack**: EA's own LZ77-style compression for package resources, alongside zlib; marked 0xFFFF in the index and used in the game's builds mostly for world files and string tables. Save streams start with the bytes 0x50 0xFB. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md), [8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **region**: Tuning record for one town on the world picker; sets sun times, weather, buildable venues, region buffs, fishing data and which towns count as compatible. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **region description**: Catalog (client) id for a region; Region.REGION_DESCRIPTION_TUNING_MAP turns it into the tuning record. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **region map (RMAP)**: Resource type 0xAC16FBEC, called CASPartRegionMap by the client: per body region and layer, which meshes of a part cover it. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **region tag**: Tag listed on a region; two regions are compatible when they share any tag. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **region type**: RegionType enum on a region: NONE 0, RESIDENTIAL 1, DESTINATION 2; no installed region is a destination. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **regular outfit categories**: The eight categories a player edits in CAS: EVERYDAY, FORMAL, ATHLETIC, SLEEP, PARTY, SWIMWEAR, HOTWEATHER and COLDWEATHER. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **reincarnation**: A death option that recreates the dead Sim as an infant in a new household with some traits carried over. ([3.09](3.09-life-cycle.md))
- **relabelled claim**: A checked claim whose label moved between Observed and Inferred. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **relationship**: The single record two Sims (or a Sim and an object) share, keyed by the pair of ids sorted low to high. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship bit**: A label on a relationship (Friend, Spouse, Despised), added by a track threshold, a loot or an event. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship culling**: Removal of a relationship, by the convergence timer or by story progression for played NPCs. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship depth**: The sum of the depth values of every bit on a relationship; story progression culls the shallowest first. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship expectations**: Four yes or no traits on exclusivity and openness to change, rolled for generated Sims. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship metrics**: The 14-field RelationshipMetrics tuple from get_relationship_metrics: relationship counts by active, played and unplayed, bit and track counts, the average meaningful relationships and sentiment counts; written to telemetry around each culling pass. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **relationship track**: A bar on a relationship, -100 to 100 for friendship and romance, that decays toward its convergence value. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relationship-count goal**: A situation goal met when enough ordered pairs of Sims of interest satisfy a set of relationship bit rules. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **relative Sim**: In a jig, the Sim who stays roughly in place while the other walks over; by default the target (RelativeToSimB). ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **relic**: A GP06 object fused from a top and a bottom, optionally with a crystal set into it. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **relic combo**: One RelicComboId: a top and bottom pair (9) or a pair with a crystal of a given quality (27), with the description texts a Sim sees once it is learned. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **relic tracker**: The per-Sim record of the relic combos that Sim has learned; kept only while the Sim is at full detail. ([6.03](6.03-pack-systems.md))
- **repeal petition**: A policy marked up for repeal; it is repealed at the close if it has at least REPEAL_PETITION_THRESHOLD (5) signatures. ([2.07](2.07-neighbourhood-systems.md))
- **repo man**: The RepoSituation NPC who takes objects whose depreciated value is closest to the debt, up to 10, until the bill is covered. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **repurposing**: Reusing an existing unimportant or constrained Sim for a filter request by conforming it, instead of creating a new Sim. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **reputation**: A ranked statistic that starts at 200 and has seven ranks from Terrible to Pristine; EP06. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **request factory**: A request that stays in the manager and makes a fresh request each time, used so the street's own director always returns. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **`REQUEST_AUTOSAVE`**: Distributor op the autosave service sends to the client when an autosave is due; the client performs the save. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **required bait**: A fish's bait buff requirement: without that bait the fish cannot be chosen. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **`required_flags`**: The randomize flags that must be enabled for a CAS_RANDOMIZE_FILTERS button to be enabled, separate from the flags it rolls. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **`required_packs`**: A class property on services and components listing packs, one of which must be available: otherwise the service is never registered or the component never added. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **reservation**: A claim on an object or part that keeps other Sims from using it; made late, about 5 m before arriving. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **reservation handler**: The object that holds one reservation and decides who else may share it (exclusive, all parts, multi, interlocked, use list). ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **reservation request**: A bouncer request that holds a Sim for a situation without moving them; meant to keep other situations off that Sim. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **reserved space**: The clearance box (front, back, left, right) a jig keeps around each Sim; defaults depend on species and age. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **reset reason**: How severe a reset is: NONE, RESET_EXPECTED, RESET_ON_ERROR or BEING_DESTROYED. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **reset record**: The reset service's entry for one object: reason, source, cause, stage and the elements to hard-stop. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **resettable element**: The element at the root of an object's task that registers with the object so a reset can hard-stop it. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **residential switch**: ZoneDirectorResidentialSwitch, which picks a house, apartment or penthouse director, player or NPC version. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **residential zone fixup**: The zone fixup of the residential venue, which puts leftover NPC visitors back into greeted or ungreeted visit situations on load. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **Resistance Solis**: Vampire power perk line that slows sun damage; level 3 is the daywalker perk. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **resolver**: The object that fills participant types for a test or loot: InteractionResolver, SingleSimResolver, DoubleObjectResolver and others. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **resource**: One stored item in a package (a texture, a model, a sound, a string table, a tuning file), found by its key. ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **resource key**: The three numbers that name a resource in the game's package files: type (32 bits), instance (64 bits) and group (32 bits). The native Key takes them in the order type, instance, group; tuning writes a key as type:group:instance in hex. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **resource priority**: The number in a Resource.cfg that decides which package's copy of a resource key wins; higher wins. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **`Resource.cfg`**: A small text file that lists which packages the game mounts and at which priority (also ResourceClient.cfg and ResourceSimulation.cfg). ([8.01](8.01-package-files.md))
- **`respect_lod_on_add`**: Statistic tunable that makes min_lod_value apply even while the Sim is spawned; without it a spawned Sim keeps statistics down to BACKGROUND. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **restricted affordances**: A tip's filter of which pie-menu actions are visible and which are enabled while it is active. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **resume crafting**: The interaction that picks up an unfinished object and continues its process; resumable_by_different_sim decides whether another Sim may do it. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **retirement**: Leaving all careers for a daily pension of 60% of the last daily pay. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **reward**: A Reward record (SimReward or HouseholdReward) bundling money, objects, traits, CAS parts, bucks, buffs and other payouts. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **rig**: Skeleton resource (type 0x8EAF13DE): bones with position, rotation, scale, mirror and parent, plus chains; human rigs, such as the adult auRig, have 165 bones. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md), [8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **ring-doorbell walk-by**: A walk-by that rings the front door, falls back to the mailbox, then waits to be invited in. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **RLE2**: Texture type 0x3453CF95: run-length packed DXT5 (or L8) image; the diffuse texture of every CAS part. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **RLES**: Texture type 0xBA856C78: run-length packed DXT5 image; the specular texture slot of CAS parts. ([8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **robe channel**: A second set of three bytes per DMAP texel, present when the header's robe byte is nonzero, with its own value range when that byte is 0. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **role priority**: LOW, NORMAL or HIGH; only the roles in a Sim's highest non-empty priority are active, plus any always-active role. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **role state**: The per-job package of buffs, autonomy modifiers and on-activate behaviour that tells a Sim in a job what to do. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **romantic combo**: A romance label chosen from a two-axis table of romance against friendship (Lovebirds, Soulmates, HotAndCold). ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **room id**: Native integer id of the room at a point; Python only compares ids for equality. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **roommate leave reason**: One of five conditions (age up, low energy, motive distress, overcapacity, pregnancy) whose time adds up toward warning and evicting a roommate (EP08). ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **roommate rent**: Rent each roommate owes on Sundays and Wednesdays at 10:00: the home lot's value times 0.0175, divided by the household members plus roommates and rounded down; a roommate with the non-payer trait often skips it and the amount is added to what it owes (EP08). ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md), [4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **root stock**: A plant's own main fruit spawner, which a shoot carries to the plant it is grafted on. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **route event**: An animation, balloon, carry or posture change scheduled to play part-way along a route. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **route event provider**: Something (most often a buff) that adds route events, such as animations or balloons, to a Sim's walks while it applies. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **route lockout**: The time a Sim ignores an object after failing to reach it: 15 Sim minutes in the live tuning. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **routing formation**: A master Sim and slaves that route together, such as a leash or a rider. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **royalty**: A RoyaltyPayment entry that pays a Sim daily at 10:00 along a pay curve, for books, songs, apps, games and videos. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **RTTI**: Run-time type information: the C++ class names a native library keeps, readable without running it. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md))
- **rule file**: A .sgr script in the client folder that scores the hardware and picks graphics settings. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **Run-away cooldown**: The 7200 Sim minute period after a pet returns during which no pet of that household can run away. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **`run_persistence_operation`**: The native call that writes (or reads) a protobuf for a slot and reports back through a callback whose success flag Python ignores. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **runtime commodity**: A commodity class generated in code at run time and registered under a hashed name instead of coming from a tuning instance; timed buffs use them. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **runtime slot**: The script-side view of one slot on one live object: its children, location and type set. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
## S

- **safe-to-skip test**: A test (23 classes, such as mood, buff and motive tests) that is treated as passing when an interaction starts from the queue. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **satisfaction point multiplier**: A game effect that scales points from wants; it is applied twice, so x3 pays x9. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **satisfaction points**: The currency wants pay, spent in the satisfaction store on traits, potions and objects; positive gains are scaled by the Sim's score multiplier. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md), [5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **satisfaction store**: SATISFACTION_STORE_ITEMS, the 124 rewards bought with satisfaction points. ([3.07](3.07-personality-feelings.md))
- **satisfied**: Marked when an interaction's content has done its job (at once for one-shot content); ends the guaranteed state. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **save cooldown**: SAVE_GAME_COOLDOWN real seconds between cooled-down saves; 0 in this build and checked only by persistence.save_game. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **save lock**: A hold on saving by an object with get_lock_save_reason (a death, aging, a situation, an interaction liability); the UI shows its reason and saves fail with FAILED_SAVE_LOCKED. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **save reminder**: A notification loot fired on the active Sim every 15 to 120 real minutes by option, chosen 200 to 1 between a regular and an unhinged set. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **save slot**: One saved game, stored as one file named after its slot id; the autosave uses slot 0xFFFFFFFF. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **save timeline**: The scheduling timeline the persistence service creates for a save; while it exists, the server tick simulates only it and the world is frozen. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **`save_all_services`**: ServiceManager method running every pre_save then every save in reverse start order; an exception aborts the save. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **`save_error_code`**: The persistence service's current ErrorCodes value during a save; each step and each service sets its own so a failure names its source. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **saveable interaction**: A super interaction whose saveable flag is set; only these are written into a Sim's interaction state and restored on load. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **SaveGameData (namedtuple)**: Python request record for one save: slot_id, slot_name, force_override, auto_save_slot_id. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **SaveGameData (record)**: The protobuf the persistence service keeps in memory for the whole session: slot, account, neighbourhoods, households, Sims, zones, streets. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **SaveGameData resource**: Type 0x0000000D, instance equal to SaveGameData.guid: the main protobuf record of the save. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **SaveGameDataDescOnly**: A reduced view of SaveGameData with the same field numbers, enough to list a slot's name, versions and households. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **SaveGameResult**: Outcome of a save: SUCCESS 0, FAILED_ON_COOLDOWN 1, FAILED_EXCEPTION_OCCURRED 2, FAILED_SAVE_LOCKED 3, FAILED_STORAGE_FULL 4 (never set by Python). ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **SaveGameSlotMetaData**: The load menu's per-slot entry built outside the file: name, versions, pack ids, incompatible flag. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **SaveLockLiability**: Interaction liability (tuned as save_lock in basic_liabilities) that locks saving while the interaction is queued or running. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **SaveSlotData**: The slot header and save-wide state: slot id and name, versions, packs, and gameplay_data with one sub-record per service. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **scandal secret**: An EP21 secret held by the secrets service that can be revealed into a timed scandal with buffs and loots. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **scenario**: A main-menu story (snippet Scenario) applied to a household: goals or phases, start loot, optional starting money, and an ending screen. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **scenario NPC filter**: A Sim filter on a scenario (scenario_npc_sims) that finds or conforms an NPC the story needs, such as a rival; the found Sim is remembered for tests and validation. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **ScenarioEntryMethod**: Flag set saying how a household enters a scenario: NEW_HOUSEHOLD 1 or EXISTING_HOUSEHOLD 2. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **ScenarioOutcome**: An ending of a scenario: loot, tests, title, description, next-steps text and icons, shown on the outcome screen (op 1212). ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **ScenarioPhase**: A chapter of a phase scenario: objective text, pre-tests, intro loot, goal sequences, ordered outputs, a fallback and terminators. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **ScenarioRole**: A role in a scenario (snippet) with CAS criteria and requirement text; the scenario maps household Sims to roles and can add role traits. ([4.05](4.05-scenarios-moments.md))
- **schedule entry**: One window in a weekly schedule: the days it runs, a start time, a duration in hours, and an optional random start. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **schema**: The description of a SimData row: name, size and typed columns. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **scholarship**: An EP08 snippet that pays a fixed sum or an evaluated sum toward tuition, won by a roll against its merit, need or test-based score. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **scholarship letter**: The reward object that remembers which Sim applied for which scholarship, so it can show name, amount and description. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **school career**: Grade school or high school, run as an unpaid career with five grades F to A. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **science fair**: The EP12 chess or computer contest, booked on request 24 to 48 hours ahead. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **SCLP**: Sculpt resource (type 0x9D1AB874): a preset face shape with its own BGEO or DMAPs, an icon and optional bone factors. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **score multiplier**: An autonomy modifier entry that multiplies a need's urgency for ranking and scoring. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **scored loot picker**: The scored_loot_picker op: runs the loot list with the highest TestedSum score. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **ScoredStatistic**: A need's current urgency times the product of the Sim's score multipliers for it; the value that ranks needs. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **scoring bucket**: A group of drama nodes scored together, with days, a node count and an optional refresh rule. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **scoring priority**: An affordance's priority bucket (VERY HIGH to VERY LOW, INVALID if untuned); the first non-empty bucket supplies every candidate. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **scratch slot**: Slot 0, named "scratch": the engine's working copy, written when a client leaves a lot (travel or quit) and by persistence.save_game. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **screen slam**: The large centred banner snippet, sent only for the selected Sim unless tuned otherwise. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **script request**: An autonomy request made by code or an interaction rather than the alarm; it skips FullAutonomy.test and the multitasking roll. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **sculpt**: A preset face region shape (eyes, nose, mouth, cheeks, chin, jaw, forehead) chosen in Create a Sim; a Sim stores 5 to 7 of them. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **season length option**: SeasonLength NORMAL, LONG or VERY_LONG: 7, 14 or 28 days per season. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **season loop value**: The client SEASON channel: 0 to 4, whole numbers at mid-seasons (0 summer, 1 fall, 2 winter, 3 spring). ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **season segment**: SeasonSegment: EARLY, MID or LATE part of a season, set by the season's early and late lengths. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **season service**: SeasonService: the zone service that runs the season calendar, seasonal curves and season changes; registered only when EP05 is available. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **season-aware component**: SeasonAwareComponent: maps each season to an object state value; EP05 only. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **seasonal forecasts**: The weather_seasonal_forecasts snippet: EARLY, MID and LATE each mapped to a forecast list. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **seasonal parameter**: A per-place curve (leaf accumulation, flower growth, foliage reduction, foliage colour shift) of keyframes by season and time in season. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **seasonal sunrise and sunset**: Per-season overrides of a world's sunrise and sunset; read only when the seasons pack (EP05) provides a season service. ([2.05](2.05-sky-and-moon.md))
- **seating cluster**: A group of nearby seats found by density that social constraints snap to. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **secret keeper**: A Sim who knows another Sim's secret; the pair's status is discovered, promised to keep, blackmailed or undiscovered. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **sectional sofa**: A modular sofa built from pieces chained left to right; its seats are generated from the pieces' neighbours. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **seed**: A SituationSeed: the type, guest list, purpose and creation data from which a situation is started, loaded or carried across travel. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **seed purpose**: Why a seed exists: NORMAL, TRAVEL, PERSISTENCE or PERSISTED_TRAVEL. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **segmented path**: A posture graph search split into a left part (out to standing), an optional middle part (picking something up) and a right part (into the destination). ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **Sell value commodity**: A fixed-value commodity added by some pet traits that multiplies the 50 Simoleon base price when the pet is sold. ([3.12](3.12-pets-horses.md))
- **sentiment**: A one-way feeling toward another Sim (Close, Hurt, Bitter), short or long term, that starts at 100 and fades. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **sentiment cap**: The most sentiments one Sim can hold toward another, 4. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **sentimental tattoo**: A tattoo dedicated to another Sim with a sentiment type (family, lover, pet or friend). ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **server clock**: The real-time clock that never goes backwards; it drives the wall-clock timeline and the game clock's frame delta. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **server tick**: One call of c_api_server_tick: clock update, zone update and one distributor flush. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **service**: A long-lived gameplay system with setup, start, stop, save and load hooks, run by a service manager. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **service NPC**: A tuned hired or scheduled NPC service (maid, repair, gardener, nanny, deliveries, mail carrier) with a weekly work schedule. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **service record**: The per-household ServiceNpcRecord: hired and recurring flags, preferred and fired Sims, last start and finish times. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **serving**: One portion of a multi-serving dish; large recipes make 8, medium 4, group-cooked meals 12, and each grab takes one. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **session id**: The id of one client connection; the Python Client's id. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **shape map**: The DMAP of a pair that holds position offsets, -0.2 to +0.2 m per axis in 255 steps. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **shared group**: The g element at the top of a combined file that holds every subtree used more than once, each with an index x. ([8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **shared liability**: A liability that is copied to child interactions and runs its clean-up only when every copy has been released. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **shared node**: A tuning subtree stored once in the combined tuning's shared group, addressed by its index (x) and referenced from many records by r elements. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
- **shave**: Time the server trims off a batch's sleep to run ahead of the client, at most 5 frames, half the must-run time and the 1 s debt budget. ([3.06](3.06-animation.md))
- **shift**: A scheduled block in a job or zone director that sets how many Sims or situations should run from a given hour. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **shift strictness**: DESTROY ends the previous shift's situations at a shift change; OVERLAP lets them run on and counts them. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **shoo**: Kicking a lower-priority Sim off an object, or out of a private area, so another can use it. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **short walk style**: The style used for routes under the short-walk distance (7 m for Sims by default). ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **shut-off reason**: One of the UtilityShutoffReasonPriority values that keeps a utility off, such as BILLS_DELINQUENT or OFF_THE_GRID. ([5.01](5.01-money-bills-rewards.md))
- **Sickness**: Tuning instance (type SICKNESS) for one illness: symptoms, buffs, diagnosis thresholds, treatments, weight and restrictions; all live ones are EP04 pet illnesses. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **`SICKNESS_CHANCE`**: TestedSum in module tuning giving the daily percent chance to fall ill (live base 3). ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **`SICKNESS_TESTS`**: Module test set a Sim must pass before the daily sickness roll (adult or elder cat or dog, not sick, no blocking buff, not a ghost). ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **SicknessService**: Base-game service that rolls the daily pet sickness for the active household and gives or removes illnesses. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **SicknessSystem**: EP01 (Get to Work) human illness built from buffs and commodities, independent of the sickness package; patch data only here. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **SicknessTracker**: Per-Sim-info tracker holding the current illness, illness history and diagnosis progress. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **side group**: A social group living inside another group (games, objects, jigs) that has no circle geometry and never adjusts positions. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **silenced phone**: A saved option that makes ringing dialogs with buttons answer themselves without reaching the client. ([7.01](7.01-ui-dialogs-tutorials.md))
- **sim competition**: An EP21 tournament with an entry fee, rounds and Simoleon prizes by placement. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **Sim filter**: A tuned request for Sims: terms that score each Sim, how to pick among matches, and how to create a new Sim if none fits. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **Sim info cap**: The total number of Sim infos a save is meant to hold and story progression aims for: the per-LOD caps plus the household size 8, 1,041 live. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md), [4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **Sim info fixup**: A tuned list of one-time changes (career, skill, unlock, outfit and others) applied to a Sim on creation, first load, or joining the active household. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **Sim info level of detail**: How much of a Sim info the game keeps loaded; the sim_info.lod commands raise, lower and cap it. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **Sim info LOD**: A Sim info's level of detail (SimInfoLODLevel): how much of a Sim's data the game keeps in memory, from MINIMUM 1 up to ACTIVE 125. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **Sim info tracker**: A per-Sim data holder listed in SimInfo.SIM_INFO_TRACKERS that is created, notified or deleted on each LOD change according to its threshold. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **Sim IRQ**: The yield point long Python work calls so native code can run before the script frame ends. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **sim knowledge**: What one Sim knows about another: traits, career, orientation, net worth, expectations, secrets. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **Sim lifecycle state**: The stage an instanced Sim is in on the lot (resetting, initializing, running, being removed); it decides whether the Sim may receive work. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **Sim minute**: One minute of game time, 1,500 ticks, and the usual time unit in tuning (TunableSimMinute); 1.5 real seconds at normal speed. ([0.01](0.01-reading-guide.md), [1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **Sim render LOD distances**: RenderSimLODDistances: four distances per Sim quality tier at which a Sim's rendered detail steps down. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **Sim responsiveness**: Wall-clock seconds from a Sim dequeuing a super interaction (backdated by its test time) to its transition being planned; the worst value is polled by the native side. ([1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **sim timeline**: The world timeline of scheduled elements that runs in game time and is advanced to the game clock each frame. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **Sim-time autosave**: Autosave at the next Sim midnight, daily or weekly on Sunday. ([1.02](1.02-saves-persistence.md))
- **`sim_creation_path`**: SimData field telling how a Sim entered the save: NONE, INIT, REENTRY_ADDSIM, GALLERY, PRE_MADE or CLONED. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **SimCreator**: The description of a Sim to make (age, gender, species, names, traits, style tags, randomization settings, optional .siminfo resource) passed to SimSpawner.create_sim_infos. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **SimData**
  1. A binary DATA resource (type 0x545AC67A) holding one tuning record's client-exported fields, keyed by the record's id: the client's copy of tunables marked for client export. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md), [8.01](8.01-package-files.md), [8.02](8.02-tuning-formats.md))
  2. The protobuf the native generate_household returns for each new Sim, which Python then loads into a SimInfo. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **SimInfo**
  1. The gameplay record of one Sim (sims/sim_info.py): the native look record plus 33 trackers for traits, needs, careers, relationships and the rest. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
  2. SIMINFO resource (type 0x025ED6F4): a stored Sim's look and basics in a binary layout, such as physique floats, skin tone, the sculpt list, the face and body modifier lists, outfits, genetics and traits. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md), [8.03](8.03-sim-cas-files.md))
- **SIMINFO resource**: The package resource (type 0x025ED6F4) holding a saved Sim look, loaded by premade Sims, by a SimCreator with a resource key and as the CAS Stories silhouette. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **SimInfoBaseWrapper**: The Python class that wraps the native _cas.SimInfo record and forwards its fields: age, gender, species, skin tone, physique, outfits, voice and genetics. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **simoleon value map**: A recipe field that multiplies the item's value by its states, such as quality grade, masterwork or Marketable. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **SimRegion**: Python enum of face and body slider regions (EYES 0 to BODY 28 and pet regions above). ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **simulate to time**: An Automation command that runs the game at a chosen speed until a target time, answering dialogs on its own. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **simulator debt**: How far the world timeline lags behind the game clock, in Sim minutes; it builds up when a frame's time budget runs out. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md), [1.03](1.03-performance-lod.md))
- **single-choice picker**: A picker that, when only one row qualifies, offers that row directly as a named pie menu entry. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **singleton factory**: A factory tunable that builds its object once at load and shares it. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **SIState**: The per-Sim set of running super interactions; a new one displaces any it is incompatible with. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **situation**: A tuned script that gathers Sims into jobs for a purpose (party, walk-by, service visit, ghost walk) and runs until its duration alarm fires or it ends itself. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **situation activity**: A holiday tradition with the holiday-only fields removed, offered as an activity of a planned event. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **situation curve**: An hour-keyed table of situations and counts; the entry with the latest start hour at or before now applies. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **situation job**: A slot in a situation with a Sim filter, spawn settings, an auto-invite priority and rules for no-shows and Sims who die or leave. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **situation manager**: The service that creates, caps, saves and destroys situations and owns the bouncer and the default leave and visit situations. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **situation scheduler component**: Object component that carries an object's own situation shifts or weekly schedule and starts situations targeted at the object. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **situation shift**: A time curve of desired situation counts that a scheduling zone director keeps topped up. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **situation state**: One step of a complex situation; it sets job and role changes, registers for test events and may carry a time-out. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **SituationComplex**: A situation that moves between SituationState objects on events and alarms. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **SituationSimple**: A situation that moves through a fixed list of phases. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **skewer**: The column of the household's Sim portraits in the live mode interface; clicking a portrait sends the Live command sims.skewer_icon_activated, and UPDATE_SKEWER_THUMBNAIL (285) asks the client to redraw one portrait. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md), [7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **skewer alert**: An optional alert on the Sim's portrait in the household bar, sent when the Sim enters a commodity's distress and cleared when it leaves. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **skill**: A continuous statistic whose points convert to a level through a level list; it never decays. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **skill effectiveness**: The named gain curve an interaction uses for a skill, read at the Sim's level when the interaction starts. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **skill level list**: The points each level of a skill costs, chosen by the skill's level type (MAJOR, MINOR, CHILD, TODDLER, POTTY, VAMPIRE_LORE). ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **skill tag modifier**: A multiplier a buff applies to every skill carrying a given tag; one modifier can apply once per matching tag. ([3.10](3.10-skills-careers-school.md))
- **skill value curve**: A recipe curve that multiplies the item's value by the maker's skill level, for example x0.5 at level 0 to x2 at level 10 for mac and cheese. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **skinning**: Moving each vertex with the bones it is weighted to; head, body, clothes and hair are all skinned to the same rig. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **SKINTONE**: The package resource (type 0x0354796A) for one skin tone; a Sim record stores its instance id plus a lightness shift. ([3.01](3.01-create-a-sim.md))
- **`skip_load`**: Load mode for Sims with a creation path; trackers skip or filter parts of the saved data. ([7.03](7.03-thumbnails-gallery.md))
- **sleep schedule**: The Sim component tuning that hands out hidden bedtime buffs at set hours before the next work start. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **slider (modifier)**: One one-way face or body shape control stored on a Sim as an SMOD index and a weight from 0 to 1; opposite directions are separate SMODs. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **slot**: A named bone on a parent object's rig where a child object can be attached. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **slot file**: Slot_%08x.save: one save slot as a DBPF 2.1 package with five resource types. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **slot item transfer**: Element that moves the children of objects (harvest all, closing a sales table) into a Sim's or household's inventory ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **slot resource (RSLT)**: The package resource listing a model's slots, with each containment slot's name, bone, decorative size and slot type set. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **slot strategy**: Tuning that puts objects into a target's runtime slots, by one slot type or by auto-slotting ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **slot thumbnail**: Type 0x00000014, instance 0: the 180 x 120 JPEG of the slot. ([8.04](8.04-save-file-format.md))
- **slot type**: A tuned category of slot (a seat, a burner, a decoration size) that parents offer and children accept. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **slot type set**: A tuned group of slot types; a containment slot or an object names one. ([2.03](2.03-build-buy-placement.md))
- **small business seed**: A ready-made small business record (name, icon, customer rules, attendance criteria and mode, perks, premade staff) that a premade Sim or a venue is given at creation. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **SMOD**: SimModifier resource (type 0xC5F6763E): one slider, found by the FNV-1 64 hash of its lowercased name, naming a BGEO, a BOND and/or two DMAPs. ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **snippet**: A small reusable tuning record of a named kind (test set, notification, outfit) that other records reference or inline. ([0.03](0.03-tuning-system.md))
- **snooping secret**: An EP15 secret one Sim learns about another by snooping, stored in the snooper's knowledge. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **snow behaviour**: SnowBehavior per place and season: NO_SNOW, ACCUMULATE or PERMANENT; PERMANENT caps the temperature at Cold and keeps snow, ice and frost full. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **snow cover**: The SNOW_ACCUMULATION ground-cover channel: builds only at Freezing while snow falls, melts at a temperature rate, negative while melting. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **snow freshness**: The SNOW_FRESHNESS channel: rises during snow above 0.1 and fades over about 50 Sim minutes after it stops. ([2.04](2.04-weather-seasons-ground.md))
- **soak test**: An EA QA run that keeps the game going for a long time; the soak commands repeat a party, a maid and a repair visit on alarms. ([1.04](1.04-debug-cheats-telemetry.md))
- **social adjustment**: The periodic push that moves the worst-placed Sim in a group to a better spot. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **social autonomy**: The SocialAutonomy mode: picks the social mixer to use on one target Sim after "socialize with" was chosen. ([3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **social boredom**: The count of times an actor has used the same social on the same listener in a row; at 3 the social fails. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **social context**: The short-term mood of a conversation (Friendly, Tedious, Steamy, Awkward), held on four tracks per pair. ([3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **social geometry**: The scoring of where each Sim in a group should stand: distance, facing and overlap curves. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **social group**: The object that holds the Sims in one conversation, their constraints and the adjustment alarm; it also remembers repeated socials for boredom. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md), [3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **social mixer**: One social action, such as Ask About Day: a mixer that needs a social group and a second Sim and runs inside a social super interaction. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md), [3.08](3.08-relationships-socials.md))
- **social super interaction**: The super interaction that creates or joins a social group so socials can run. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **soft stop**: A request that an element end at its next safe point; must-run children still run. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **`SOFT_TRANSITION`**: VFX stop type 0, used for a normal stop; HARD_TRANSITION (1) is used for an immediate stop. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **sort layer**: A CASP number that orders drawing, from 0 (earrings) up to 17,200 (wrist parts). ([3.02](3.02-cas-sculpting-parts.md))
- **sound channel**: A unique id per PlaySound, used to address that sound when stopping it or skipping to the next song. ([7.02](7.02-audio-vfx-camera.md))
- **source venue**: The venue that owns a set of sub-venues; for a plain venue it is the active venue itself. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **sparse message**: A protobuf wrapper that records which fields were set, so an update carries only the changed fields. ([0.02](0.02-architecture.md))
- **spawn action**: How a Sim appears after spawning: fade in, do nothing, push an interaction, or ride in on a vehicle. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **spawn point**: A spot where Sims appear or leave; world spawn points come from the world file, dynamic ones are made by objects or interactions. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **spawn reason**: Why a Sim is being placed on the lot (lot owner, traveler, user add, situation and so on); its order sets the Sim's place in the spawn queue. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **spawn request**: A queued order to put a Sim from the save onto the current lot, carrying a spawn reason, a spawn point and an action to run on arrival. ([4.02](4.02-story-progression-townies.md))
- **spawn weight**: The weight of an object in a spawner's weighted pick; for fruit it comes from collection rarity (40, 9, 1). ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **spawner**: An object part that creates other objects on the ground near it or in its slots, on a commodity clock or a weekly schedule. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **special bar night**: A themed evening situation (happy hour, ladies night and so on) that a bar's special schedule starts; its records come from EP02. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **special event**: A situation from a venue's special-event schedule that can invite the active Sim. ([2.01](2.01-lots-venues-rooms.md))
- **SpecialScoring**: A bucket with no days and a count of 0, so the daily loop never draws its nodes; other code schedules them. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **speed multiplier type**: A named set of speed multipliers (DEFAULT, LOW_PERFORMANCE and others) that tuning or a liability can swap in. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **speed request**: An entry asking the game clock for a speed, with an optional validity check; the first valid request on the stack sets the speed. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **speed source**: Which layer a speed request belongs to: SITUATION, UI_MODAL, GAMEPLAY or INITIAL, walked in that order. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **spell**: A GP08 SPELL instance unlocked in the Sim's unlock tracker; it provides interactions. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **spellbook**: The GP08 book UI built by SpellbookHelper from ui.spellbook_tuning categories. ([3.11](3.11-occults.md))
- **spin-up state**: One step of the zone spin-up, with an enter hook and an update hook that report when it is done. ([1.01](1.01-time-scheduling-loading.md))
- **splice**: Taking a cutting (a shoot) from a plant; the source plant loses 30 evolution. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **splicing recipe**: A fruit tuning entry that adds a third, result fruit when a given fruit is grafted onto that plant. ([6.02](6.02-gardening-fishing-collecting.md))
- **split travel**: Go-home travel while other selectable Sims stay behind: the leaving Sims are injected into the target zone, saved and destroyed without a load. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md))
- **spoiled**: The freshness state food reaches when its freshness runs out; spoiled ingredients are used last and drag the ingredient average down. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **sports day**: The EP12 cheer (Friday) or football (Thursday) contest, booked weekly four weeks ahead. ([4.04](4.04-events-holidays-festivals.md))
- **sprinkler head**: The object spawned at the ceiling over an unsuppressed fire, which suppresses fires within 3 m. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **squad**: A Sim's saved group of followers summoned together by the squad gathering situation. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **staffed object**: An object a staff situation claims for its Sim through an object relationship; the situation ends if the object is destroyed. ([4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
- **staging content**: Flexible-length content that plays to a stage point and holds there, keeping the Sim in the activity. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **stan**: Fan who follows a Sim with the Stan quirk, found by filter_FanStan_Stan and blocked off-home by a cooldown bit. ([3.13](3.13-health-luck-fame.md))
- **stand-slot reservation**: A small reserved standing spot at a route's end that other Sims are pushed out of. ([3.05](3.05-interactions-postures-routing.md))
- **star rating value**: The hidden 0 to 100 number behind a business's stars; a stepped curve turns it into 1 to 5 half stars. ([5.02](5.02-businesses.md))
- **start-crafting interaction**: A station interaction whose recipes list is the crafting menu; 237 live records cover player menus, autonomy, orders and group cooking. ([6.01](6.01-crafting-cooking.md))
- **stat-backed state**: An object state whose value follows ranges of a linked statistic, such as brokenness or dirtiness. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **state test**: The `state` test: compares an object state value on the participants with an operator; a target lacking the state fails or is skipped per fallback_behavior. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **state value**: One value of an object state; it carries the client-state operation that runs when the state takes it. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **`state_based_value_mod`**: The additive multiplier on an object's value that state value changes lower (Broken 0.5, burnt 1.0) and restore. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **StateTrigger**: A rule in a state component that sets states, rolls a random state, changes statistics or runs door loots when listed states hold. ([2.02](2.02-objects-states-wear.md))
- **static commodity**: An on/off want with one urgency value (ad_data) and a fixed value of 0, granted by buffs and never saved; objects and interactions advertise it with a tuned desire so autonomy knows what they offer. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md), [3.04](3.04-autonomy.md))
- **static modifier priority**: The order StatisticStaticModifier applies in: DELTA 0, NORMALIZE 1, then CEILING, FLOOR and MULTIPLY. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **statistic**: A named number on a Sim or object with a minimum, a maximum and a default; the base of needs, skills, relationship tracks and many hidden counters. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **statistic tracker**: The container on a Sim or object that holds its discrete statistics, their listeners, watchers and seeds, and saves them. ([3.03](3.03-needs-statistics.md))
- **statistics op**: The most used loot op; a variant of 12 statistic and 13 relationship sub-ops. ([0.04](0.04-tests-loot-effects.md))
- **stayover**: An EP13 (Growing Together) visit in which an invited Sim or a newly generated relative stays at the household's home as a travel group for some days. ([2.06](2.06-worlds-regions-travel.md), [4.01](4.01-situations-npcs.md))
